traits.text:
The arcane blademaster is a 20th level spellcaster. Their spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 19 +11 to hit with spell attacks). The arcane blademaster has the following wizard spells prepared:

- **Cantrips** (at will): Acid Splash, Fire Bolt, Shocking Grasp, true strike
- **1st-Level** (4 slots): Burning Hands, Charm Person, Magic Missile, sleep
- **2nd-Level** (3 slots): Magic Weapon, Misty Step, See Invisibility
- **3rd-Level** (3 slots): Dispel Magic, Fireball, fly, Lightning Bolt, Tongues
- **4th-Level** (3 slots): Fire Shield, stoneskin, Wall of Fire
- **5th-level** (3 slots): Cone of Cold, Conjure Elemental, Hold Monster, Telekinesis
- **6th-level** (2 slots): Globe of Invulnerability, Sunbeam
- **7th-Level** (2 slots): Teleport, Unholy Star
- **8th-Level** (1 slot): Power Word Stun
- **9th-Level** (1 slot): Meteor Swarm

traits.name: Steel Focus
traits.text: The blademaster has advantage on Constitution saving throws made to maintain concentration on spells.

traits.name: Superior Heavy Armor Master
traits.text: While wearing heavy armor, the blademaster reduces any bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage they take from nonmagical weapons by 5.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The arcane blademaster attacks four times and casts a cantrip.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (1d8 + 7) slashing damage.

actions.name: Composite Longbow
actions.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Shocking Grasp
actions.text: (Cantrip; V, S) Melee Spell Attack: +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 18 (4d8) lightning damage  and the target can't take reactions until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Fire Bolt
actions.text: (Cantrip; V, S) Ranged Spell Attack: +11 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (4d10) fire damage.

actions.name: Globe of Invulnerability
actions.text: (6th-Level; V, S, M, Concentration) A glimmering 10-foot-radius sphere appears around the blademaster. It remains for 1 minute and doesnt move with the blademaster. Any 5th-level or lower spell cast from outside the sphere can't affect anything inside the sphere  even if cast with a higher level spell slot. Targeting something inside the sphere or including the spheres space in an area has no effect on anything inside.

actions.name: Teleport
actions.text: (7th-Level; V) The blademaster teleports to a location they are familiar with on the same plane of existence.

actions.name: Unholy Star

Four fiery chunks of the meteor then plummet to the ground at different points chosen by the blademaster that are within range  to explode in 5-foot-radius areas. Each creature in an area makes a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw  taking 21 (6d6) fire damage and 21 (6d6) necrotic damage on a failed save or half damage on a successful one. A creature in more than one area is affected only once. Flammable unattended objects catch fire.

actions.name: Power Word Stun
actions.text: (8th-Level; V) The blademaster utters a powerful word that stuns one creature that has 150 hit points or less and is within 60 feet (if it has more hit points  it is instead rattled until the end of its next turn). The creature repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns  ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Meteor Swarm
actions.text: (9th-Level; V, S) Scorching 40-foot-radius spheres of flame strike the ground at 4 different points chosen by the blademaster within 1 mile. The effects of a sphere reach around corners. Creatures and objects in the area make a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw  taking 49 (14d6) fire damage and 49 (14d6) bludgeoning damage on a failure or half damage on a success. A creature in more than one area is affected only once. Flammable unattended objects catch fire.

bonusActions.name: Improved War Magic
bonusActions.text: When the blademaster uses an action to cast a spell, they can make one weapon attack.

bonusActions.name: Misty Step
bonusActions.text: (2nd-Level; V) The blademaster teleports to an unoccupied space they can see within 30 feet. The blademaster can't cast this spell and a 1st-level or higher spell on the same turn.

legendaryActions.name: Fire Bolt
legendaryActions.text: The arcane blademaster makes one Fire Bolt attack.

legendaryActions.name: Move
legendaryActions.text: The arcane blademaster moves up to half its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

legendaryActions.name: Meteor Swarm (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.text:

The panels must connect perpendicular to each other, forming a corner behind the arx. If the wall falls in a creature's space when the arx places it, the creature must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, the creature takes 10 (3d6) bludgeoning damage, and the arx determines to which side of the wall the creature is pushed. On a success, the creature takes half the damage and decides to which side of the wall it is pushed.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.text: The asanbosam can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The asanbosam makes one Bite attack and one Claws attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or take 11 (2d10) poison damage and contract a disease. Until the disease ends, the creature is poisoned. Every 24 hours that elapse, the infected creature must repeat the saving throw. On a success, the disease ends. On a failure, the creature's hp maximum is reduced by 5 (1d10). This reduction lasts until the disease ends. The target dies if its hp maximum is reduced to 0.

actions.name: Claws
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (3d10 + 4) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 14). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the asanbosam can't use its Claws on another target. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or contract the disease described in the Bite attack.

bonusActions.name: Arboreal Escape
bonusActions.text: While in a tree, the asanbosam takes the Disengage or Hide action.

added.name: Ascetic Grandmaster

traits.name: Athlete
traits.text: The grandmaster only uses 5 feet of movement when standing from prone and can make a running jump after moving only 5 feet rather than 10.

traits.name: Evasion
traits.text: When the grandmaster makes a Dexterity saving throw against an effect that deals half damage on a success, they take no damage on a success and half damage on a failure.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The grandmaster has advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects.

traits.name: Mobile
traits.text: After the grandmaster makes a melee attack against a creature on their turn, until the end of their turn they do not provoke opportunity attacks from that creature.

traits.name: Reactive
traits.text: The grandmaster can take a reaction on each creatures turn.

traits.name: Stunning Strike (1/Turn)
traits.text: When the grandmaster hits a creature with a melee attack, they can force it to make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, it is stunned until the end of the grandmasters next turn.

traits.name: Unarmored Defense
traits.text: The grandmasters AC equals 10 + their Dexterity modifier + their Wisdom modifier.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The grandmaster attacks six times.

actions.name: Unarmed Strike
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

bonusActions.name: Trained Dash
bonusActions.text: The grandmaster takes the Dash action.

reactions.name: Deft Dodge
reactions.text: When an attacker that the grandmaster can see hits them with an attack, the grandmaster halves the attacks damage against them.

legendaryActions.name: Unarmed Strike
legendaryActions.text: The ascetic grandmaster makes one Unarmed Strike attack.

legendaryActions.name: Move
legendaryActions.text: The ascetic grandmaster moves up to half its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

legendaryActions.name: Crushing Blow (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.text: The ascetic grandmaster makes one Unarmed Strike attack with Advantage. On a hit, the target also has the Prone condition if it is Huge or smaller.

added.legendaryActionsIntro: Legendary Action Uses: 3. Immediately after another creature's turn, the ascetic grandmaster can spend a use to take one of these actions. It regains all its uses at the start of each of its turns. _(Added by this site for major monsters; the DM can leave them out.)_

traits.name: Firesight
traits.text: The ash drake can see through areas obscured by fire, smoke, and fog without penalty.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The drake makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) fire damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Ash Cloud (Recharge 6)
actions.text: The ash drake beats its wings, filling the area within 10 feet of it with ash for 1 minute. The ash spreads around corners, and its area is heavily obscured. Each creature that isn't an ash drake and that enters the cloud for the first time on its turn or starts its turn there must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or become blinded until the end of its next turn. The ash moves with the drake, remaining centered on it for the duration.

actions.name: Ash Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.text: The ash drake spews blistering hot, choking ash in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in the area must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 14 (4d6) fire damage and is poisoned for 1 minute. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't poisoned. A poisoned creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

added.name: Ash Phoenix
added.resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
added.immunities: necrotic, poison; exhaustion, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.text: While the ash phoenix hovers and remains motionless, except for drifting on air currents, it is indistinguishable from a normal cloud of ash and smoke.

traits.name: Rejuvenation
traits.text: If the ash phoenix’s birth site hasn’t been purified by holy rites, a destroyed ash phoenix gains a new body in 1d10 days, regaining all its hp and becoming active again. The new body appears within 5 feet of its birth site.

traits.name: Shadow Stealth
traits.text: While in dim light or darkness, the ash phoenix can take the Hide action as a bonus action.

traits.name: Wind Weakness
traits.text: While in an area of strong wind (at least 20 miles per hour), the ash phoenix has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The ash phoenix makes two ash talon attacks. If both attacks hit the same target, the phoenix plunges its beak into the target, and the target must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or take 7 (2d6) necrotic damage. The ash phoenix regains hp equal to half the necrotic damage dealt.

actions.name: Ash Talons
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage.

actions.name: Ash Storm (Recharge 5–6)
actions.text: The ash phoenix furiously beats its wings, throwing clinging ash into a 30-foot cone. Each creature in the area must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 28 (8d6) necrotic damage and is blinded until the end of its next turn. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't blinded.

added.name: Ashen Custodian
added.resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Fire Controller
traits.text: As a bonus action, the ashen custodian can create or extinguish a nonmagical fire in a 5-foot cube within 30 feet of her, or she can expand an existing fire within 30 feet of her by 5 feet in one direction. If she creates or expands a fire, the target location must have suitable fuel for the fire, such as paper or wood. If the ashen custodian targets a fire elemental with this trait, the fire elemental has advantage (expanded) or disadvantage (extinguished) on attack rolls until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Forest Cleanser
traits.text: When the ashen custodian hits a plant or plant creature with her Cleansing Strike, the target takes an extra 2d8 fire damage.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.text:
The ashen custodian’s innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 15). The ashen custodian can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: druidcraft, produce flame
3/day each: burning hands, cure wounds, flame blade, fog cloud
1/day each: conjure elemental (fire elemental only), wall of fire

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The ashen custodian has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Warming Presence
traits.text: When a hostile creature starts its turn within 10 feet of the ashen custodian, the creature must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 3 (1d6) fire damage. When a friendly creature within 10 feet of the ashen custodian regains hp, the creature regains an extra 1d6 hp.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The ashen custodian makes two cleansing strike attacks.

actions.name: Cleansing Strike
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) fire damage. If the target is a creature or a flammable object, it ignites. Until a creature takes an action to douse the fire, the target takes 5 (1d10) fire damage at the start of each of its turns.

added.name: Ashwalker
added.languages: understands all languages it knew in life but can't speak

traits.name: Breath Born
traits.text: The ashwalker has immunity to a type of damage based on the type of dragon that killed it: acid (black, copper), cold (silver, white), fire (brass, gold, red), lightning (blue, bronze), or poison (green).

traits.name: Burst of Breath
traits.text: A creature that touches the ashwalker or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 3 (1d6) damage of the type noted in its Breath Born trait.

traits.name: Last Breath
traits.text: The first time the ashwalker is reduced to 0 hp, it drops to 1 hp instead and its Draconic Breath automatically recharges. The ashwalker transforms into raw energy of the type noted in its Breath Born trait. While in this energy form, it is immune to all damage and to being grappled or restrained. At the end of the ashwalker’s next turn, it is destroyed.

traits.name: Undead Nature
traits.text: The ashwalker doesn’t require air, food, drink, or sleep.

actions.name: Slam
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) damage of the type noted in the ashwalker's Breath Born trait.

actions.name: Draconic Breath (Recharge 6)
actions.text: The ashwalker exhales elemental energy in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in the area must make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw, taking 14 (4d6) damage of the type noted in its Breath Born trait on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.text: While motionless indistinguishable from normal cluster of vines.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Four Vine attacks.

actions.name: Vine
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 4 (1d4+2) piercing damage and 5 (2d4) poison and the target must make DC 14 Con save or be poisoned for 1 min. If the target is a creature it is grappled (escape DC 14). Until this grapple ends the target is restrained and must succeed on a new save each round it remains grappled or take another 5 (2d4) poison. The asp vine can grapple up to four targets at a time though it can still make vine attacks vs. other targets even if it has four grappled opponents.

added.name: Astral Devourer
added.immunities: poison, psychic; grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, stunned

traits.name: Collective Mind
traits.text: The astral devourer’s individual serpents are connected via a hive mind. It can telepathically communicate with any of its individual serpents within 1 mile of it, and it can’t be surprised.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The astral devourer has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Swarm
traits.text: The astral devourer can occupy another creature’s space and vice versa, and the devourer can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny serpent. Except via Serpent Spray and Recombine, the astral devourer can’t regain hp or gain temporary hp.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The astral devourer makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Hungering Serpents
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target in the swarm's space. Hit: 8 (2d8) piercing damage, or 4 (1d8) piercing damage if the swarm has half of its hit points or fewer, plus 14 (4d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Serpent Spray (Recharge 6)
actions.text: The astral devourer flings biting astral serpents outward. Each creature within 20 feet of the astral devourer must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 (4d6) piercing damage and 14 (4d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The astral devourer regains hp equal to the single highest amount of piercing damage dealt by this spray.

reactions.name: Divide
reactions.text: When an astral devourer that is Small or larger takes bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage, it can split into two new astral devourers if it has at least 10 hp. Each new devourer has hp equal to half the original creature, rounded down. New astral devourers are one size smaller than the original. While within 1 mile of each other, the new astral devourers share one collective mind.

reactions.name: Recombine
reactions.text: When one or more astral devourers that are Small or smaller and share a collective mind are within 5 feet of each other, they can combine into a new astral devourer. The new astral devourer is one size larger than the largest original creature, and it has hp equal to the combined total of the original creatures. The new astral devourer's hp can't exceed the normal hp maximum of a Medium astral devourer.

added.name: Astral Snapper
added.resistances: bludgeoning and slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Astral Devour
traits.text:
A creature hosting an astral snapper's astral form must make a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw each time it finishes a long rest. On a success, the astral snapper is ejected from the host and the Astral Plane into an unoccupied space in the Material Plane within 10 feet of the host and is stunned for 1 round. On a failure, the astral snapper consumes part of the host's internal organs, reducing the host's Constitution score by 1d4. The host dies if this reduces its Constitution to 0. The reduction lasts until the host finishes a long rest after the astral snapper has been expelled. If the host's Constitution score is reduced to 0, the astral snapper exits the host's body in the Material Plane by tearing its way out through the abdomen. The astral snapper becomes completely corporeal as it exits the host, stepping out of the host at its full size.

From the time the astral snapper succeeds on the initial dive into the host through the Astral Plane until the moment it emerges from the host's abdomen, it can be seen by any creature that can see into the Astral Plane-its head buried in the host's back. The astral snapper has disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks and is effectively stunned when in this position until it takes damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The astral snapper makes two attacks with its claws. If both attacks hit the same target, the target must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or its wound becomes a rift to the Astral Plane. The astral snapper immediately passes through, closing the rift behind it. The target is then affected by the astral snapper's Astral Devour trait.

actions.name: Claws
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) slashing damage.

traits.name: Apposable Thumbs
traits.text: Advantage on climb-related Str (Athletics).

traits.name: Keen Hearing
traits.text: [+]and Smell[/+] Advantage: hearing/smell Wis (Perception).

bonusActions.name: Astral Traveler (2/Day)
bonusActions.text: Briefly surrounds itself in a shower of glittering dust and teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet.

reactions.name: Playing Dead
reactions.text: When reduced to 10 hp or less it feigns death in hopes of deceiving its attackers. A creature that sees it in this state can determine it is a ruse via DC 15 Wis (Medicine) check. Ruse lasts until astralsupial ends it (no action required) up to 8 hrs. 1st attack it makes within 1 round of ending ruse has advantage.

added.name: Astri
added.resistances: poison; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Enforce Good Deeds
traits.text: A creature that has received assistance, such as food or healing, from the astri must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or be affected by the geas spell for 30 days. While under the geas, the affected creature must assist nonhostile creatures suffering from injury or exhaustion by alleviating the injury or exhaustion.

traits.name: Helping Hand
traits.text: The astri can take the Help action as a bonus action on each of its turns.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.text:
The astri’s spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 16, +8 to hit with spell attacks). The astri can cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: create or destroy water, detect poison and disease, produce flame, purify food and drink
3/day each: bless, create food and water, lesser restoration
1/day each: remove curse

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The astri has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.text: The astri’s weapon attacks are magical.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The astri makes three bite attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) radiant damage.

actions.name: Healing Touch (3/Day)
actions.text: The astri touches another creature. The target magically regains 14 (3d8 + 1) hit points and is freed from any disease, poison, blindness, or deafness.

reactions.name: Defensive Counter
reactions.text: When a creature within 5 feet of the astri makes an attack against a creature other than the astri, the astri can bite the attacker. To do so, the astri must be able to see the attacker.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.text:
The attercroppe’s spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 12). The attercroppe can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: poison spray
3/day each: create or destroy water, fog cloud
1/day each: misty step, suggestion

traits.name: Poisonous Aura
traits.text: The attercroppe radiates an aura of insidious poison that slowly pollutes any water source. in which it immerses itself. Each hour the attercroppe is fully immersed in water, its aura transforms up to 10 gallons of the water into a deadly poison. A creature that drinks this poisoned water must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or take 10 (3d6) poison damage and become poisoned for 1 hour.

traits.name: Water Invisibility
traits.text: While fully immersed in water, the attercroppe is invisible. If it attacks, it becomes visible until the start of its next turn. The attercroppe can suppress this invisibility until the start of its next turn as a bonus action.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing damage.

traits.name: Aura of Subservience
traits.text: A beast or humanoid that ends its turn within 30 feet of the august rooster and can see or hear it must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed for 1 day. A charmed creature that moves more than 100 feet away from the august rooster ceases to be charmed. If the august rooster requests that a charmed creature do more than tend to the creature’s own needs, pay devotion to the august rooster, or bring the rooster food and gifts, the charmed creature can make a new saving throw with advantage. If a creature’s saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the august rooster’s Aura of Subservience for 24 hours.

traits.name: Dive Bomb
traits.text: If the august rooster is flying and moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a talon attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 7 (2d6) slashing damage.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.text:
The august rooster’s innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 14). The august rooster can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components.
At will: dancing lights, mage hand, message, vicious mockery
3/day each: bane, charm person, hideous laughter
1/day each: healing word, hold person

traits.name: Jumper
traits.text: The august rooster can fly up to 40 feet on its turn, but it must start and end its movement on a solid surface such as a roof or the ground. If it is flying at the end of its turn, it falls to the ground and takes falling damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The august rooster makes two talon attacks.

actions.name: Talon
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage.

traits.name: Blind Senses
traits.text: Can’t use its blindsight while deafened and unable to smell.

traits.name: Keen Hearing
traits.text: Has advantage on Wis (Perception) checks that rely on hearing.

traits.name: Sonic Sensitivity
traits.text: When it takes thunder damage it becomes deafened until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Two Claws attacks and one Rib Hooks attack. It can use Consume Sound in place of one attack.

actions.name: Claws
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 12 (2d8+3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Rib Hooks
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 10 (2d6+3) piercing damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 15) if it is a Large or smaller creature and it doesn't have another creature grappled.

actions.name: Consume Sound
actions.text: Siphons energy from audible vibrations surrounding a creature grappled by it. Target: 14 (4d6) necrotic and becomes deafened and unable to speak until end of its next turn (DC 13 Con half damage and is able to hear and speak). Aural hunter regains hp equal to damage dealt. Consume Sound has no effect on creatures that are already deafened and unable to speak. It can't use this action if it is deafened.

added.name: Aurora Horribilis
added.immunities: cold, psychic, radiant; exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.text: The aurora horribilis can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Reality Adjacent
traits.text:
The aurora horribilis does not fully exist in physical space. If the aurora is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a saving throw to take only half damage, it instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails. In addition, attack rolls against it have disadvantage. A creature with truesight doesn’t have disadvantage on its attack rolls, but if that creature looks at the aurora, it must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or be incapacitated with a speed of 0 for 1 minute. An incapacitated creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

This trait is disrupted while the aurora is incapacitated or has a speed of 0.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The aurora horribilis makes two blistering touch attacks.

actions.name: Blistering Touch
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) cold damage plus 10 (3d6) radiant damage.

actions.name: Void Song
actions.text:
The aurora horribilis creates a dissonant song. Each creature within 100 feet of the aurora that can hear the song must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed until the song ends. This song has no effect on constructs, undead, or creatures that can speak or understand Void Speech. The aurora must take a bonus action on its subsequent turns to continue singing. It can stop singing at any time. The song ends if the aurora is incapacitated.

While charmed by the aurora, the target suffers the effects of the confusion spell and hums along with the maddening tune. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. A target that successfully saves is immune to this aurora's song for the next 24 hours. A target that stays charmed by the aurora's song for more than 1 minute gains one long-term madness.

added.name: Automata Devil
added.resistances: cold; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks not made with silvered weapons

traits.name: Devil’s Sight
traits.text: Magical darkness doesn’t impede the devil’s darkvision.

traits.name: Fear Aura
traits.text: A creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the automata devil must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened until the start of its next turn. On a successful saving throw, the creature is immune to the automata devil’s Fear Aura for 24 hours.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The automata devil has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The automata devil makes one Bite attack, one Whip attack, and two Claw attacks. It can replace two Claw attacks with a use of Shredding Maw.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (2d10 + 7) slashing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d8 + 7) slashing damage.

actions.name: Whip
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d4 + 7) slashing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 17). The automata devil has two whips, each of which can grapple only one target.

actions.name: Shredding Maw
actions.text: One creature grappled by the automata devil is pulled up to 10 feet toward the devil's central maw, which shreds the creature with churning gears, razor teeth, and whirling blades. The target must make a DC 17 Strength saving throw, taking 36 (8d8) slashing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Teleport
actions.text: The automata devil magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

traits.name: Snow Camouflage
traits.text: The avalanche screamer has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in snowy terrain.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The avalanche screamer makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its legs.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) thunder damage.

actions.name: Leg
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage. If the avalanche screamer scores a critical hit against a creature that is Medium or smaller, the creature is impaled on the screamer's leg and grappled (escape DC 15). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained and takes 3 (1d6) piercing damage at the start of each of its turns. The avalanche screamer can impale up to four creatures. If it has at least one creature impaled, it can't move. If it has four creatures impaled, it can't make leg attacks. It can release all impaled creatures as a bonus action.

actions.name: Scream (Recharge 5–6)
actions.text: The avalanche screamer shrieks thunderously in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 27 (6d8) thunder damage and is deafened for 1 hour. On a success, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't deafened.

added.name: Avatar of Shoth
added.immunities: acid, cold, fire; charmed, frightened, prone
added.senses: Blindsight 60 ft., Truesight 60 ft.; Passive Perception 22

traits.name: Absorbent
traits.text: When the avatar damages a creature, it absorbs a portion of that creature's knowledge and power. As a bonus action, it can recreate any action available to a creature it damaged within the last minute. This includes spells and actions with limited uses or with a recharge. This recreated action is resolved using the avatar's statistics where applicable.

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.text: The avatar, including its equipment, can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting (Psionics)
traits.text:
The avatar's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell casting DC 21, +13 to hit with spell attacks). It may cast the following spells innately, requiring no components:
At will: acid splash (4d6), light, spare the dying, true strike
3/day each: bless, blur, command, darkness, enthrall, shield
2/day each: counterspell, dispel magic
1/day each: black tentacles, confusion

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.text: If the avatar fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Soothing Aura
traits.text: Any creature hostile to the avatar that starts its turn within 30 feet of the avatar must succeed on a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw or have disadvantage on all attack rolls until the end of its next turn. Creatures with Intelligence 3 or lower automatically fail the saving throw.

actions.name: Acid Wave (Costs 2 Actions)
actions.text: The avatar uses Acid Wave, if it is available.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The avatar makes three oozing tentacle attacks.

actions.name: Legendary Merge
actions.text: A shoth with less than half its maximum hp can merge with any other shoth creature within 10 feet, adding its remaining hp to that creature's. The hp gained this way can exceed the normal maximum of that creature. The avatar can accept any number of such mergers.

actions.name: Consult the Zom (1/Day)
actions.text: The avatar uses its action to consult its weighty zom for insight. The zom flashes brilliant crimson-and-white light. Each creature within 120 feet who can see the avatar must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the end of its next turn. Each creature of the avatar's choice within 120 feet that speaks a language must succeed on a DC 20 Charisma saving throw or be stunned until the end of its next turn as the avatar telepathically utters a short expression that is particularly meaningful to that creature.

legendaryActions.name: At Will Spell
legendaryActions.text: The avatar casts one at will spell.

legendaryActions.name: Oozing Tentacle
legendaryActions.text: The avatar makes one oozing tentacle attack.

legendaryActions.name: Acid Wave (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.text: The avatar uses Acid Wave, if it is available.

added.legendaryActionsIntro: Legendary Action Uses: 3. Immediately after another creature's turn, the avatar of shoth can spend a use to take one of these actions. It regains all its uses at the start of each of its turns.

mythicTrait.name: Mythic Resurgence (1/Day)
mythicTrait.text: If the avatar of shoth is reduced to 0 Hit Points, it doesn't die or fall Unconscious. Instead it ends every condition on itself and regains 170 Hit Points (half its maximum). Until the end of the fight it can also use the Mythic Actions below.

mythicActions.name: Unleashed Consult the Zom (Costs 2 Actions)
mythicActions.text:
The avatar of shoth uses Consult the Zom, even if it isn't recharged or has no uses left.

The avatar uses its action to consult its weighty zom for insight. The zom flashes brilliant crimson-and-white light. Each creature within 120 feet who can see the avatar must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the end of its next turn. Each creature of the avatar's choice within 120 feet that speaks a language must succeed on a DC 20 Charisma saving throw or be stunned until the end of its next turn as the avatar telepathically utters a short expression that is particularly meaningful to that creature.

mythicActions.name: Shrug It Off
mythicActions.text: The avatar of shoth ends one condition on itself and gains 34 Temporary Hit Points.

mythicActions.name: Terrible Presence (Costs 2 Actions)
mythicActions.text: _Wisdom Saving Throw:_ DC 21, each enemy within 30 feet that can see the avatar of shoth. _Failure:_ The target has the Frightened condition until the end of its next turn.

mythicActions.name: Sweep Aside
mythicActions.text: _Strength Saving Throw:_ DC 20, each creature within 10 feet of the avatar of shoth. _Failure:_ The target is pushed up to 10 feet away and has the Prone condition.

added.mythicActionsIntro: Once Mythic Resurgence has been used, the avatar of shoth can spend its Legendary Action uses on these options too. _(Added by this site; the DM can leave them out.)_

reactions.name: Dig In
reactions.text: Has resistance to one melee weapon attack that would hit it. To do so the avestruzii must see the attacker and must not have moved during its previous turn.

reactions.name: Dig In
reactions.text: As Avestruzi above.

traits.name: Divine Rejuvenation
traits.text: An aviere that dies collapses into a pile of ash. Each day the pile of ash is within 1 mile of a holy site of its deity or a worshiper of its deity, it has a 75 percent chance of returning to life, regaining all its hit points and becoming active again. This chance increases to 100 percent if a worshiper of the aviere’s deity prays over the aviere’s ashes at dawn. If unholy water is sprinkled on the aviere’s ashes, the aviere can’t return to life, except through a wish spell or divine will.

traits.name: Illumination
traits.text: The aviere sheds bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The aviere has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.text: The aviere’s weapon attacks are magical.

actions.name: Claw
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage plus 4 (1d8) fire damage.

actions.name: Song of Life
actions.text: The aviere sings a song against death. The aviere chooses one creature it can see within 30 feet of it that has 0 hp and isn't an undead or a construct. The creature becomes stable.

actions.name: Song of Healing (1/Day)
actions.text: The aviere sings a song of healing. The aviere chooses one creature within 60 feet of it. If the creature can hear the aviere's song and isn't an undead or a construct, it regains 1d4 hp.

added.name: Avulzor
added.resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Bone Kilt
traits.text: The avulzor wears a kilt made out of the bones of the many humanoids it has slain. The kilt increases the avulzor’s Armor Class by 3. If lost, the avulzor can create a new bone kilt with ample bones and 1 hour of work. The avulzor can use its Animate Bones as a bonus action if it targets the bone kilt. Doing so creates 1 skeleton of CR 2 or lower, but the avulzor subsequently reduces its Armor Class by 3.

traits.name: Bone Shaping
traits.text:
The avulzor can shape bones with its touch, altering the appearance, function, size, and density of bone to match its needs. It can’t use this trait to alter the bones of a living creature, but it can otherwise alter any bone it touches that isn’t being worn or carried. In addition, as a bonus action, the avulzor can touch any skeleton it created with its Animate Bones action and grant the target one of the following benefits until the end of the target’s next turn:
* Armor Class increases by 2
* Reach increases by 5 feet
* Melee weapon attacks deal an extra 1d4 damage of the weapon’s type.
* Speed increases by 10 feet.

traits.name: Turning Defiance
traits.text: Friendly undead within 30 feet of the avulzor have advantage on saving throws against effects that turn undead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The avulzor makes two claw attacks and two synchronized bite attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Synchronized Bite
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (4d4 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Animate Bones (Recharge 5–6)
actions.text: The avulzor creates a skeleton out of a pile of bones or a the corpse of a Large or smaller creature within 10 feet of it. The skeleton is under the control of the avulzor, obeying the avulzor's mental commands, and uses the statistics of a CR 1 or lower skeleton of your choice. The avulzor can control up to three skeletons at one time. If the avulzor creates a skeleton while it already has three under its control, the oldest skeleton crumbles to dust.

At will: dancing lights, disguise self, faerie fire, minor illusion
3/day each: creation, major image, mislead, seeming
1/day each: mirage arcane, programmed illusion

traits.name: Magic Resistance

actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws

actions.name: Ear-Splitting Yawp (Recharge 5–6)
actions.text: The azeban emits a piercing yell in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in the area must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a target takes 21 (6d6) thunder damage and is deafened for 1 minute. On a success, a creature takes half the damage but isn't deafened. A creature made of inorganic material such as stone, crystal, or metal has disadvantage on this saving throw. A nonmagical object that isn't being worn or carried also takes the damage if it's in the area.

traits.name: Heated Body
traits.text: A creature that touches the azer or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 3 (1d6) fire damage.

traits.name: Heated Weapons
traits.text: When the azer hits with a metal melee weapon, the weapon deals an extra 3 (1d6) fire damage (included in the attack).

traits.name: Illumination
traits.text: The azer sheds bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The azer makes two Warhammer attacks.

actions.name: Warhammer
actions.text: _Melee Weapon Attack:_ +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. _Hit:_ 7 (1d8+3) bludgeoning damage, or 8 (1d10+3) bludgeoning damage if used with two hands, plus 3 (1d6) fire damage.

bonusActions.name: Blazing Bulwark
bonusActions.text: The azer creates fire in a 15-foot line that is 1 foot wide, originating from a point the azer can see within 15 feet of it. This line is an opaque wall that is 3 feet tall and provides half-cover to creatures behind it. A creature that moves through the line takes damage as if it touched the azer. The line of fire lasts for 1 minute or until the azer uses this bonus action again.

traits.name: Fiery Aura
traits.text: A creature that ends its turn within 5 feet of one or more azers takes 5 (1d10) fire damage. The azer sheds bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The azer attacks with its returning hammer and uses Bonfire if available.

actions.name: Returning Hammer
actions.text: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 feet  one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage. The azers hammer returns to its hand after its thrown.

actions.name: Bonfire (3/Day)
actions.text: A 5-foot-square space within 60 feet catches fire. A creature takes 10 (3d6) fire damage when it enters this area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there. A creature can use an action to extinguish this fire.

bonusActions.name: Fire Step
bonusActions.text: While standing in fire, the azer can magically teleport up to 90 feet to a space within fire.

On a success, a target takes half the bludgeoning and lightning damage and is pushed, but isn't knocked prone. All nonmagical flames in the cone are extinguished.

3/day: phantom steed (as an action)
- **2/Day Each:** darkness (black night horseman only), daylight (bright day and red sun horsemen only), dimension door, fire shield
1/day: plane shift (self and mount only)

bonusActions.name: Temporal Strike (Recharge 5–6)
bonusActions.text: One creature the horseman can see and that the horseman hit with a Horseman's Bolt or Longsword attack within the last minute must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or age 16 (3d10) years. A creature that ages this way has disadvantage on attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws that use Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution until the aging is reversed. A creature that ages beyond its lifespan dies immediately. The aging lasts until the creature finishes a long rest, or until it is reversed by a greater restoration spell or similar magic. On a successful saving throw, the creature is immune to the horseman's Temporal Strike for 24 hours.

traits.text: The balara is immune to poison damage, to exhaustion, and to the poisoned condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The balara makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks, or it makes three Necrotic Bolt attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: _Melee Weapon Attack:_ +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. _Hit:_ 16 (3d8+3) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) necrotic damage, and the target can't regain HP until the start of the balara's next turn.

actions.name: Claw
actions.text: _Melee Weapon Attack:_ +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. _Hit:_ 13 (3d6+3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Necrotic Bolt
actions.text: _Ranged Spell Attack:_ +5 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. _Hit:_ 15 (3d8+2) necrotic damage, and the target can't regain HP until the start of the balara's next turn.

reactions.name: Relentless Pursuit
reactions.text: When a creature the balara can see moves away from it, the balara can move up to half its speed toward that creature. This movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks.

added.name: Baleful Miasma
added.immunities: poison; exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, unconscious

traits.name: Air Form
traits.text: Can enter a hostile creature’s space and stop there. Can move through space as narrow as 1ft. wide with o squeezing.

traits.name: Asphyxiate
traits.text: If a creature that breathes air starts its turn in miasma’s space it must make DC 12 Con save or begin suffocating as its lungs fill with the poisonous air emitted by the miasma. Suffocation lasts until creature ends its turn in a space not occupied by baleful miasma or the baleful miasma dies. When the suffocation ends the creature is poisoned until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Elemental Nature
traits.text: Doesn’t require air food drink or sleep.

reactions.name: Swift Advance
reactions.text: If a creature in same space as miasma moves miasma can move up to its speed with the creature. This move doesn't provoke opportunity attacks but miasma must move in same spaces creature moved ending in creature's space or space nearest to it.

added.name: Baliri Demon
added.resistances: cold, fire, lightning; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The baliri has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Praising Brays
traits.text: As a bonus action, the baliri brays praise to the demon lord that saved it from its previous life, channeling the demon lord’s might. The baliri chooses up to three demons within 30 feet of it. Each target has advantage on the first ability check or attack roll it makes before the start of the baliri’s next turn. In addition, the targets are unaffected by the baliri’s Blood Bray.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The baliri demon makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its pincers.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Pincers
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) slashing damage. If the baliri demon scores a critical hit against a creature, roll a d6. On a 1-3, it severs the target's arm, and on a 4-6 it severs the target's leg. A creature missing an arm can't wield weapons that require two hands, and if a creature is missing a leg, its speed is halved. Creatures without limbs are unaffected.

actions.name: Blood Bray (Recharge 6)
actions.text: The baliri demon unleashes an otherworldly braying that causes the internal organs of nearby creatures to twist and rupture. Each creature within 20 feet of the baliri that can hear it must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the creature takes 36 (8d8) necrotic damage and is stunned until the end of its next turn as it doubles over in agony. On a success, the creature takes half the damage and isn't stunned. The bray doesn't affect creatures without internal organs, such as constructs, elementals, and oozes.

legendaryActions.name: Bite
legendaryActions.text: The baliri demon makes one Bite attack.

legendaryActions.name: Move
legendaryActions.text: The baliri demon moves up to half its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

legendaryActions.name: Crushing Blow (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.text: The baliri demon makes one Bite attack with Advantage. On a hit, the target also has the Prone condition if it is Huge or smaller.

added.legendaryActionsIntro: Legendary Action Uses: 3. Immediately after another creature's turn, the baliri demon can spend a use to take one of these actions. It regains all its uses at the start of each of its turns. _(Added by this site for major monsters; the DM can leave them out.)_

added.name: Balloon Spider
added.senses: Blindsight 10 ft., Darkvision 60 ft.; Passive Perception 13

traits.name: Erratic Discharge
traits.text: A creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the balloon spider must make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the creature takes 2 (1d4) lightning damage and can move or take an action on its turn, but not both. On a success, the creature gains the benefits of the haste spell until the end of its turn. If a creature’s saving throw is successful, it is immune to the spider’s Erratic Discharge for the next 24 hours.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage plus 5 (2d4) lightning damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or it can move or take an action on its turn, but not both.

actions.name: Charged Web (Recharge 4–6)
actions.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 40/80 ft., one creature. Hit: The target is grappled (escape DC 13) by strands of charged webbing and begins to hover off the ground. Until this grapple ends, the target takes 1 lightning damage at the start of each of its turns. In addition, the grappled target can make a DC 12 Dexterity (Acrobatics) check to manipulate the strands of webbing and fly 10 feet in any direction.

actions.name: Draw In
actions.text: The balloon spider magically pulls all creatures grappled by its webbing up to 10 feet toward it. If this movement pulls the creature within 5 feet of the balloon spider, the spider can make one bite attack against the creature as a bonus action.

added.name: Balor General
added.resistances: cold, lightning; damage from nonmagical weapons

traits.name: Chaotic Evil
traits.text: The balor radiates a Chaotic and Evil aura.

traits.name: Death Throes
traits.text: When the balor dies, it explodes. Each creature within 30 feet makes a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw, taking 52 (15d6) fire damage on a failed save or half damage on a success.

traits.name: Fast Reflexes
traits.text: The balor general may take two reactions per round, but not more than one per turn.

traits.name: Fire Aura
traits.text: At the start of the balors turn, each creature within 10 feet takes 10 (3d6) fire damage. A creature that touches the balor or hits it with a melee attack takes 10 (3d6) fire damage.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
traits.text: If the balor general fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. When it does so, it wards itself with its sword. The lightning that wreathes the sword winks out. The lightning reappears at the beginning of the balors next turn. Until then, the balors lightning sword deals no lightning damage, and the balor can't use Avenging Bolt.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The balor has advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The balor attacks with its lightning sword and its fire whip.

actions.name: Lightning Sword
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (3d8 + 8) slashing damage plus 18 (4d8) lightning damage.

actions.name: Fire Whip
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 45 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d6 + 8) slashing damage plus 14 (4d6) fire damage  and the target makes a DC 19 Strength saving throw. On a failure  it is pulled up to 40 feet towards the balor.

actions.name: Whip Crack (1/Day)
actions.text: A 90-foot cone of thunderous flame emanates from the balor. Each creature in the area makes a DC 19 Constitution saving throw  taking 28 (8d6) fire damage and 28 (8d6) thunder damage and falling prone on a failed save or taking half damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Teleport
actions.text: The balor magically teleports to a space within 120 feet that it can see.

reactions.name: Avenging Sword
reactions.text: When damaged by a melee weapon attack, the balor attacks with its lightning sword.

reactions.name: Hunters Whip
reactions.text: When damaged by a ranged weapon attack, spell, area effect, or magical effect, the balor uses Teleport and then attacks with its fire whip.

reactions.name: Avenging Bolt (1/Day)
reactions.text: When damaged by a ranged weapon attack, spell, or magical effect, a 100-foot-long, 5-foot-wide lightning bolt springs from the balors extended sword. Each creature in the area makes a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw, taking 42 (12d6) lightning damage on a failed save or half damage on a success.

legendaryActions.name: Lightning Sword
legendaryActions.text: The balor general makes one Lightning Sword attack.

legendaryActions.name: Move
legendaryActions.text: The balor general moves up to half its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

legendaryActions.name: Crushing Blow (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.text: The balor general makes one Lightning Sword attack with Advantage. On a hit, the target also has the Prone condition if it is Huge or smaller.

added.legendaryActionsIntro: Legendary Action Uses: 3. Immediately after another creature's turn, the balor general can spend a use to take one of these actions. It regains all its uses at the start of each of its turns. _(Added by this site for major monsters; the DM can leave them out.)_

mythicTrait.name: Mythic Resurgence (1/Day)
mythicTrait.text: If the balor general is reduced to 0 Hit Points, it doesn't die or fall Unconscious. Instead it ends every condition on itself and regains 189 Hit Points (half its maximum). Until the end of the fight it can also use the Mythic Actions below.

mythicActions.name: Relentless Lightning Sword
mythicActions.text: The balor general makes two Lightning Sword attacks.

mythicActions.name: Unleashed Whip Crack (Costs 2 Actions)
mythicActions.text:
The balor general uses Whip Crack, even if it isn't recharged or has no uses left.

A 90-foot cone of thunderous flame emanates from the balor. Each creature in the area makes a DC 19 Constitution saving throw  taking 28 (8d6) fire damage and 28 (8d6) thunder damage and falling prone on a failed save or taking half damage on a successful one.

mythicActions.name: Shrug It Off
mythicActions.text: The balor general ends one condition on itself and gains 38 Temporary Hit Points.

mythicActions.name: Terrible Presence (Costs 2 Actions)
mythicActions.text: _Wisdom Saving Throw:_ DC 21, each enemy within 30 feet that can see the balor general. _Failure:_ The target has the Frightened condition until the end of its next turn.

mythicActions.name: Sweep Aside
mythicActions.text: _Strength Saving Throw:_ DC 23, each creature within 10 feet of the balor general. _Failure:_ The target is pushed up to 10 feet away and has the Prone condition.

added.mythicActionsIntro: Once Mythic Resurgence has been used, the balor general can spend its Legendary Action uses on these options too. _(Added by this site; the DM can leave them out.)_

traits.name: Brute
traits.text: A melee weapon deals one extra die of its damage when the bandit lord hits with it (included in the attack).

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.text: The bandit lord has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the bandit lord’s allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn’t incapacitated.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The bandit lord makes two Longsword attacks and one Dagger attack.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) slashing damage, or 14 (2d10 + 3) slashing damage if used with two hands.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.text: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage, or 8 (2d4 + 3) piercing damage if used to make a melee attack.

actions.name: Leadership
actions.text: For 1 minute, the bandit lord can utter a special command or warning whenever a nonhostile creature that it can see within 30 feet of it makes an attack roll or a saving throw. The creature can add a d4 to its roll provided it can hear and understand the bandit lord. A creature can benefit from only one Leadership die at a time. This effect ends if the bandit lord is incapacitated.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.text: The bandit lord adds 2 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it. To do so, the bandit lord must see the attacker and be wielding a weapon.

reactions.name: Protect Me!
reactions.text: When a creature the bandit lord can see targets it with an attack, the bandit lord can sidestep behind an ally within 5 feet of it, moving to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the ally. The chosen ally becomes the target of the attack instead.

traits.name: Hazesight
traits.text: Can see through areas obscured by fog smoke and steam with o penalty.

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.text: Can hold its breath for 10 min.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Two Scalding Claws attacks.

actions.name: Scalding Claws
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 5 (1d6+2) slashing damage + 3 (1d6) fire.

actions.name: Scalding Splash (Recharge 5-6)
actions.text: Summons a giant ladle full of boiling water that pours down on a point it can see within 60' of it extinguishing exposed flames within 10 ft. of that point. Each creature within 10 ft. of that point must make a DC 13 Con save. On a failure a creature takes 14 (4d6) fire and is scalded for 1 min. On a success a creature takes half the damage and isn't scalded. A scalded creature has disadvantage on weapon attack rolls and on Con saves to maintain concentration. A scalded creature can re-save at end of each of its turns success ends effect on itself.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.text: Wis (DC 13) only wand of bound fir required: At will: augury create or destroy water fog cloud3/day: lesser restoration

added.name: Banshee
added.resistances: acid, fire, lightning, thunder; damage from nonmagical weapons
added.immunities: cold, necrotic, poison; charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained
added.languages: the languages it spoke in life

traits.name: Death Howl
traits.text: When reduced to 0 hit points, the banshee uses Baleful Wail.

traits.name: Detect Life
traits.text: The banshee magically senses the general direction of living creatures up to 5 miles away.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.text: The banshee can move through creatures and objects. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Undead Nature
traits.text: A banshee doesnt require air, sustenance, or sleep.

traits.name: Unquiet Spirit
traits.text: If defeated in combat, the banshee returns on the anniversary of its death. It can be permanently put to rest only by finding and casting Remove Curse on its grave or by righting whatever wrong was done to it.

actions.name: Presage Death
actions.text: The banshee targets a creature within 60 feet that can hear it  predicting its doom. The target makes a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure  the target takes 11 (2d6 + 4) psychic damage and is magically cursed for 1 hour. While cursed in this way  the target has disadvantage on saving throws against the banshees Baleful Wail.

actions.name: Baleful Wail
actions.text: The banshee shrieks. All living creatures within 30 feet of it that can hear it make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. On a failure  a creature takes 11 (2d6 + 4) psychic damage. If the creature is cursed by the banshee  it drops to 0 hit points instead.

reactions.name: Wounded Warning
reactions.text: When the banshee takes damage from a creature within 60 feet, it uses Presage Death on the attacker.

added.name: Bar Brawl
added.immunities: charmed, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, prone, restrained, stunned

traits.name: Liquid Courage (Recharge 5-6)
traits.text: As a bonus action, the bar brawl imbibes nearby alcohol to gain access to a hidden reservoir of audacity and grit. The bar brawl gains 7 (2d6) temporary hp for 1 minute.

traits.name: Swarm
traits.text: The bar brawl can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the bar brawl can move through any opening large enough for a Medium humanoid. Except for Liquid Courage, the bar brawl can't regain hp or gain temporary hp.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The bar brawl makes two melee attacks or two darts attacks.

actions.name: Barstool
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 0 ft., one target in the bar brawl's space. Hit: 14 (4d6) bludgeoning damage, or 7 (2d6) if the bar brawl has half its hit points or fewer.

actions.name: Broken Bottles
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 0 ft., one target in the bar brawl's space. Hit: 10 (4d4) slashing damage, or 5 (2d4) if the bar brawl has half its hit points or fewer.

actions.name: Darts
actions.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, range 20/40 ft. Hit: 10 (4d4) piercing damage, or 5 (2d4) if the bar brawl has half its hit points or fewer.

traits.name: Artistic Expression
traits.text: The bard has one primary form of artistic expression, such as song, poetry, dance, fashion, paint, or similar. It is resistant to one type of damage associated with that artistic expression. For example, a bard expressing art through song or oration is resistant to thunder damage, a bard expressing art through paint is resistant to acid or poison damage (the bard's choice), and a bard expressing art through witty discourse or clever quips is resistant to psychic damage. This trait can't make the bard resistant to force, necrotic, or radiant damage.

traits.name: Expressive Weapons
traits.text: When the bard hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 3d8 damage of the type determined by Artistic Expression.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The bard makes two Rapier or Hand Crossbow attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting.

actions.name: Rapier
actions.text: _Melee Weapon Attack:_ +6 to hit, reach 5. ft., one target. _Hit:_ 7 (1d8+3) piercing damage plus 13 (3d8) damage of the type determined by Artistic Expression.

actions.name: Hand Crossbow
actions.text: _Ranged Weapon Attack:_+6 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. _Hit:_ 6 (1d6+3) piercing damage plus 13 (3d8) damage of the type determined by Artistic Expression.

actions.name: Dissonant Outburst (Recharge 4–6)
actions.text: Each creature within 30 feet of the bard and that can see or hear it must make a DC 15 WIS save. On a failure, a creature takes 14 (4d6) thunder damage and 7 (2d6) psychic damage and has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the end of its next turn. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and doesn't have disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.text:
The bard casts one of the following spells, using CHA as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15).

- **At Will:** dancing lights, mage hand, message
- **3/Day Each:** _faerie fire_, _hold_, _suggestion_
- **1/Day Each:** _confusion_, _greater invisibility_

added.name: Barometz
added.resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Fruit of the Land
traits.text: When a barometz dies, its body sprouts a myriad of nourishing fruits and vegetables. If a creature spends 10 minutes consuming the produce, it gains the benefits of a heroes’ feast spell for 8 hours. If the feast isn’t consumed within 1 hour, it disintegrates into a mound of dirt and dried leaves.

traits.name: Parent Vine
traits.text: The barometz is attached to a nearby tree by a thick vine that is between 50 and 100 feet long. The vine has AC 13, 20 hp, and resistance to all damage except for slashing damage. If this vine is severed, the barometz loses its Regeneration trait and suffers one level of exhaustion per hour until it dies.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.text: The barometz regains 5 hit points at the start of its turn. This regeneration can only be halted if the barometz’s parent vine is severed, whereupon it loses this trait. The barometz dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn’t regenerate.

traits.name: Wildland Runner
traits.text: Difficult terrain composed of forest underbrush, bushes, or vines doesn’t cost the barometz extra movement. In addition, the barometz can pass through magical and nonmagical plants without being slowed by them and without taking damage from them, including plants that are magically created or manipulated, such as those produced by the entangle and wall of thorns spells.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The barometz makes two attacks: one with its gore and one with its hooves.

actions.name: Gore
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d10 + 3) piercing damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Hooves
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Aura of Protection
traits.text: All allies within 30 feet of Barong gain a +6 bonus to saving throws as long as Barong is conscious.

traits.name: Divine Weapons
traits.text: Barong's weapon attacks are magical. When he hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 18 (4d8) radiant damage (already included below).

traits.name: Magic Resistance

traits.name: Pack Tactics

actions.name: Divine Command (Costs 2 Actions)

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Barong makes two attacks: one with his bite and one with his claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (1d8 + 7) piercing damage plus 18 (4d8) radiant damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d6 + 7) slashing damage plus 18 (4d8) radiant damage.

actions.name: Summon Spirit (1/Day)
actions.text: Barong can summon any combination of 2d4 good-aligned ghosts, uraeuses or couatls; 1d4 temple dogs, unicorns, or good-aligned wraiths; or one buraq or deva. reactions.name: Divine Protection
reactions.text: When a creature makes an attack against Barong or one of his allies within 30 feet, Barong grants the target of the attack a +5 bonus to its AC until the start of his next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Claw

legendaryActions.name: Enlightening Roar
