added.languages: understands Common and Darakhul but can't speak

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.text: The emperor’s hyena has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the hyena’s allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn’t incapacitated.

traits.name: Stench
traits.text: Any creature that starts its turn within 5 feet of the emperor’s hyena must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the start of its next turn. On a successful saving throw, the creature is immune to the emperor’s hyena’s Stench for 24 hours.

traits.name: Turning Resistance
traits.text: The emperor’s hyena has advantage on saving throws against any effect that turns undead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The emperor's hyena makes two bite attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Black Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.text: The emperor's hyena breathes a 15-foot cone of noxious black vapor. Each creature in the area that isn't an undead or a construct must make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw, taking 14 (4d6) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the creature gains one level of exhaustion. This exhaustion lasts until the creature finishes a short or long rest.

added.name: Empty Cloak
added.immunities: poison, psychic; charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned
added.languages: understands Elvish and Umbral but can't speak

traits.name: Construct Nature
traits.text: The empty cloak doesn’t require air, food, drink, or sleep.

traits.name: Diligent Sentinel
traits.text: The empty cloak has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks.

traits.name: Shadow Construction
traits.text: Made mostly of shadow, the empty cloak bursts into pieces then dissipates when a creature scores a critical hit against it.

traits.name: Wrapping Embrace
traits.text: The empty cloak can occupy a Medium or smaller creature’s space and vice versa. It has advantage on attack rolls against any creature in the same space as it.

actions.name: Razor Cloak
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Shadow Slam
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Shadow Snare
actions.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one Large or smaller creature. Hit: The target is grappled (escape DC 14). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained by tendrils of shadow. A creature, including the restrained creature, can take its action to free the restrained creature by succeeding on a DC 14 Strength check. The tendrils of shadow can be attack and destroyed (AC 12; hp 10; vulnerability to radiant damage; immunity to necrotic, poison, and psychic damage).

bonusActions.name: Protective Embrace
bonusActions.text: When a creature the cloak can see attacks a creature in the cloak's space, the cloak can briefly wrap itself around the creature in its space. The creature in its space takes only half the damage from the attack, and the cloak takes the other half.

traits.name: Ambusher
traits.text: In the first round of combat, the empusa has advantage on attack rolls against any creature she has surprised.

traits.name: Magical Copper
traits.text: The empusa’s claw and kick attacks are magical.

traits.name: Nimble Fighter
traits.text: The empusa can take the Dash or Disengage action as a bonus action on each of her turns.

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.text: The empusa can use her action to polymorph into a Small or Medium beast that has a challenge rating no higher than her own, or back into her true form. Her statistics, other than her size, are the same in each form. While transformed, at least one of her limbs has a coppery color. Any equipment she is wearing or carrying isn’t transformed. She reverts to her true form if she dies.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The empusa makes two claw attacks, or one claw attack and one kick attack.

actions.name: Claw
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage.

actions.name: Kick
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 10 feet away from the empusa and knocked prone.

added.name: Empyrean

traits.name: Divine Grace
traits.text: If the empyrean makes a saving throw against an effect that deals half damage on a success, it takes no damage on a success and half damage on a failure. Furthermore, while wearing medium armor, the empyrean adds its full Dexterity bonus to its Armor Class (already included).

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.text:
The empyreans innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 23). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

- **At Will:** Charm Person, Command, Telekinesis
- **3/Day**:  flame strike, Hold Monster, Lightning Bolt
- **1/Day** Commune, Greater Restoration, Heroes Feast, Plane Shift (self only, can't travel to or from the Material Plane)

actions.name: Maul
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +17 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 38 (8d6 + 10) bludgeoning damage plus 14 (4d6) radiant damage  and the target makes a DC 25 Strength saving throw. On a failure  the target is pushed up to 30 feet away and knocked prone.

actions.name: Lightning Bolt
actions.text: (3rd-Level; V, S) A bolt of lightning 5 feet wide and 100 feet long arcs from the empyrean. Each creature in the area makes a DC 23 Dexterity saving throw  taking 28 (8d6) lightning damage on a failure or half damage on a success.

actions.name: Flame Strike
actions.text: (5th-Level; V, S) A column of divine flame fills a 10-foot-radius  40-foot-high cylinder within 60 feet. Creatures in the area make a DC 23 Dexterity saving throw  taking 14 (4d6) fire damage and 14 (4d6) radiant damage on a failure or half damage on a success.

actions.name: Hold Monster
actions.text: (5th-Level; V, S, Concentration) One creature the empyrean can see within 60 feet makes a DC 23 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure  the target is paralyzed for 1 minute. The target repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns  ending the effect on a success.

bonusActions.name: Immortal Form
bonusActions.text: The empyrean magically changes its size between Gargantuan and Medium. While Medium, the empyrean has disadvantage on Strength checks. Its statistics are otherwise unchanged.

legendaryActions.name: Attack
legendaryActions.text: The empyrean makes a weapon attack.

legendaryActions.name: Cast Spell
legendaryActions.text: The empyrean casts a spell. The empyrean can't use this option if it has cast a spell since the start of its last turn.

legendaryActions.name: Fly
legendaryActions.text: The empyrean flies up to half its fly speed.

legendaryActions.name: Shout
legendaryActions.text: Each creature within 120 feet that can hear the empyrean makes a DC 25 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 24 (7d6) thunder damage and is stunned until the end of the empyreans next turn. On a success, a creature takes half damage.

added.legendaryActionsIntro: Legendary Action Uses: 1. Immediately after another creature's turn, the empyrean can spend a use to take one of these actions. It regains all its uses at the start of each of its turns.

mythicTrait.name: Mythic Resurgence (1/Day)
mythicTrait.text: If the empyrean is reduced to 0 Hit Points, it doesn't die or fall Unconscious. Instead it ends every condition on itself and regains 164 Hit Points (half its maximum). Until the end of the fight it can also use the Mythic Actions below.

mythicActions.name: Relentless Maul
mythicActions.text: The empyrean makes two Maul attacks.

mythicActions.name: Unleashed Lightning Bolt (Costs 2 Actions)
mythicActions.text:
The empyrean uses Lightning Bolt, even if it isn't recharged or has no uses left.

(3rd-Level; V, S) A bolt of lightning 5 feet wide and 100 feet long arcs from the empyrean. Each creature in the area makes a DC 23 Dexterity saving throw  taking 28 (8d6) lightning damage on a failure or half damage on a success.

mythicActions.name: Shrug It Off
mythicActions.text: The empyrean ends one condition on itself and gains 33 Temporary Hit Points.

mythicActions.name: Terrible Presence (Costs 2 Actions)
mythicActions.text: _Wisdom Saving Throw:_ DC 23, each enemy within 30 feet that can see the empyrean. _Failure:_ The target has the Frightened condition until the end of its next turn.

mythicActions.name: Sweep Aside
mythicActions.text: _Strength Saving Throw:_ DC 25, each creature within 10 feet of the empyrean. _Failure:_ The target is pushed up to 10 feet away and has the Prone condition.

added.mythicActionsIntro: Once Mythic Resurgence has been used, the empyrean can spend its Legendary Action uses on these options too. _(Added by this site; the DM can leave them out.)_

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.text: The enchanter has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put the enchanter to sleep.

traits.name: Reach of the Fey
traits.text: When the enchanter casts an enchantment spell of 1st level or higher that targets only one creature, the enchanter can choose to target all creatures within 10 feet of the target instead.

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.text:
The enchanter is a 13th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks). The enchanter has the following wizard spells prepared:

- **Cantrips** (at will): dancing lights, friends, mage hand, message, prestidigitation
- **1st Level** (4 slots): charm person*, hideous laughter*, magic missile
- **2nd Level** (3 slots): hold person*, invisibility, suggestion*
- **3rd Level** (3 slots): hypnotic pattern, lightning bolt
- **4th Level** (3 slots): confusion*, conjure minor elementals
- **5th Level** (2 slots): dominate person*, hold monster*, mislead, modify memory*
- **6th Level** (1 slots): irresistible dance*, chain lightning
- **7th Level** (1 slot): prismatic spray*
Enchantment spell of 1st level or higher

actions.name: Dagger
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Captivating Gaze
actions.text: The enchanter targets a creature within 30 feet of it who can see or hear the enchanter. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed for 1 minute. The charmed target's speed is reduced to 0, it is incapacitated, and it must spend each round looking at the enchanter. While looking at the enchanter, the charmed target is considered blinded to other creatures not between it and the enchanter. The charmed target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If the charmed target takes damage from one of the enchanter's allies, it has advantage on the next saving throw. The effect also ends if the creature can no longer see or hear the enchanter. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the enchanter's Captivating Gaze for the next 24 hours.

reactions.name: Beguiling Parry (Recharge 4–6)
reactions.text: When a creature within 30 feet that the enchanter can see targets it with an attack, the enchanter can stop the attacker with a glance. The attacker must succeed on a DC 15 Charisma saving throw or immediately stop the attack. The attacker can't attack the enchanter again until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.text: The enchantress has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can’t put her to sleep.

traits.name: Phrenic Weapons
traits.text: The enchantress’s weapon attacks are magical. When she hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 4d6 psychic damage (included in the attack).

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.text: While in sunlight, the shadow fey has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Rapier
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) psychic damage.

actions.text: Ranged Spell Attack: +7 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) cold damage plus 9 (2d8) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Beguiling Whispers (Recharge 5–6)
actions.text: The enchantress speaks sweet words to a creature she can see within 60 feet of her and that can hear her. The creature must succeed on a DC 15 Charisma saving throw or be charmed for 1 minute. While charmed in this way, the creature has disadvantage on Wisdom and Charisma saving throws against spells cast by the enchantress.

actions.name: Leadership
actions.text: For 1 minute, the enchantress can utter a special command or warning whenever a nonhostile creature that she can see within 30 feet of her makes an attack roll or a saving throw. The creature can add a d4 to its roll, provided it can hear and understand the enchantress. A creature can benefit from only one Leadership die at a time. This effect ends if the enchantress is incapacitated.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.text:
The enchantress casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15):

- **At Will:** command, message
3/day: charm person, enthrall, fear, hold person, hypnotic pattern
1/day: confusion, dominate person, greater invisibility, hold monster, phantasmal killer

bonusActions.name: Shadow Traveler (3/Day)
bonusActions.text: While in shadows, dim light, or darkness, the shadow fey disappears into the darkness and reappears in an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet. A tendril of inky smoke appears at the origin and destination when it uses this bonus action.

actions.name: Time-Warping Staff
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) force damage.

actions.name: Drift Forward (Recharge 5–6)
actions.text: The drifter chooses one creature it can see within 5 feet of its future self. The target must make a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, the target takes 7 (2d6) psychic damage and is pulled forward in time. On a success, the target takes half the damage and isn't pulled forward in time. A target pulled forward in time disappears, along with the drifter's future self, as the future self pulls the target with it. At the end of the drifter's next turn, the target and the drifter's future self reappear in the spaces they previously occupied, or the nearest unoccupied spaces. When the target reappears, it has disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of its next turn as it recovers from the disorienting experience.

bonusActions.name: Call to the Future (1/Day)
bonusActions.text: The eonic drifter calls to a future version of itself, which appears in an unoccupied space the drifter can see within 30 feet of it. The drifter's future self acts on the drifter's turn, and each turn it makes one Time-Warping Staff attack against a creature of the drifter's choice or uses the Help action to aid the drifter. The future self can be attacked and destroyed (AC 13; hp 30; resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage; immunity to poison and psychic damage), otherwise it remains until the drifter dismisses it as a bonus action or the drifter finishes a long rest. If the drifter's future self is destroyed, the drifter must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be stunned until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Amend Time
traits.text: As a bonus action, the savant alters the strands of time surrounding a creature it can see within 30 feet. If the target is friendly, the target has advantage on its next weapon attack roll. If the target is hostile, the target must succeed on a DC 15 Charisma saving throw or have disadvantage on its next weapon attack roll.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The savant has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Past and Future, Present
traits.text:
A savant is always accompanied by its past and future selves. They occupy the savant’s same space seconds before and after the savant and can’t be targeted separately. They provide the savant with the following benefits.
* The savant can concentrate on two spells simultaneously. If it casts a third spell that requires concentration, the savant loses concentration on the oldest spell. If the savant is concentrating on two spells and loses concentration because of taking damage, it loses concentration on the oldest spell.
* When a creature targets the savant with an attack, roll a d6. On a 1 through 4, the attack hits one of the savant’s future or past selves, halving the damage the savant takes. On a 5 or 6, the attack hits the savant, and it takes damage as normal. The savant is still the target of the attack and is subject to effects that trigger when a creature is hit or damaged.

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.text:
The savant is a 9th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 15, +8 to hit with spell attacks). The savant has the following wizard spells prepared: Cantrips (at will): fire bolt, light, mage hand, prestidigitation
- **1st Level** (4 slots): detect magic, mage armor, magic missile, sleep
- **2nd Level** (3 slots): enlarge/reduce, gust of wind, misty step
- **3rd Level** (3 slots): counterspell, fireball, fly
- **4th Level** (3 slots): arcane eye, confusion, dimension door

actions.name: Bite

A creature that fails the saving throw by 5 or more is also stunned until the end of its next turn. A blinded creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Primal Voice of Doom
actions.text: The golem intones a disturbing invocation of the sun god at one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute. The frightened target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

added.name: Eye of the Gods
added.resistances: fire, radiant; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Blazing Nimbus
traits.text: A hostile creature that touches the eye of the gods or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 3 (1d6) radiant (good or neutral eyes) or necrotic (evil eyes) damage.

traits.name: Corona of Truth
traits.text: Allies within 10 feet of the eye of the gods have truesight of 20 feet.

traits.name: Divine Conduit
traits.text: The deity that created the eye of the gods can see everything the eye sees and can instantly recall the eye to its side at any time.

traits.name: Ethereal Jaunt
traits.text: As a bonus action, the eye of the gods can magically shift from the Material Plane to the Ethereal Plane, or vice versa.

actions.name: Slam
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) radiant (good or neutral eyes) or necrotic (evil eyes) damage.

actions.name: Divine Inspiration (Recharge 5–6)
actions.text: The eye of the gods inspires all allies within 10 feet. For 1 minute, all inspired creatures have advantage on saving throws against being frightened.

added.name: Fabricator
added.resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
added.immunities: force, poison, psychic; blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone
added.languages: understands Common, Deep Speech, and Draconic but can't speak

traits.name: Assemble
traits.text: With at least 10 minutes of work, a fabricator can refine raw materials and create entirely new objects by combining material it has absorbed. For example, it can create a rope from absorbed hemp, clothing from absorbed flax or wool, and a longsword from absorbed metal. A fabricator can create intricate objects like thieves’ tools and objects with moving parts with at least 1 hour of work and twice the requisite raw materials, but it can’t create magic items. The quality of objects it creates is commensurate with the quality of the raw materials.

traits.name: Dismantling Form
traits.text: A creature that touches the fabricator or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 3 (1d6) force damage. Any nonmagical weapon made of metal or once-living material (such as bone or wood) that hits the fabricator is slowly dismantled by the minute constructs that make up the fabricator. After dealing damage, the weapon takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to damage rolls. If its penalty drops to -5, the weapon is destroyed. Nonmagical ammunition made of metal or once-living material that hits the fabricator is destroyed after dealing damage. At the start of each of its turns, the fabricator can choose whether this trait is active.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The fabricator makes two disassembling slam attacks.

actions.name: Disassembling Slam
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) force damage. A creature reduced to 0 hp by this attack immediately dies and its body and nonmagical equipment is disassembled and absorbed into the fabricator. The creature can be restored to life only by means of a true resurrection or a wish spell. The fabricator can choose to not disassemble a creature or its equipment after reducing it to 0 hp.

added.name: Faceless Wanderer
added.immunities: poison, psychic; blinded, exhaustion, poisoned, prone

traits.name: Memory Loss
traits.text: A creature that sees or interacts with a faceless wanderer must make a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw 1 minute after the faceless wanderer leaves. On a failure, the details of the faceless wanderer and the events surrounding its appearance rapidly fade away from the creature’s mind, including the presence of the faceless wanderer.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.text: The faceless wanderer regains 5 hp at the start of its turn. If a creature hasn’t failed the saving throw of the faceless wanderer’s Memory Drain within the last 1 minute, this trait doesn’t function until a creature fails it. If a faceless wanderer is reduced to 0 hp while it is still capable of regenerating, its body dissipates into vapor and reforms 1d10 days later somewhere in the Void. Otherwise, it is permanently destroyed.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The faceless wanderer makes two attacks, but it can use its Memory Drain only once.

actions.name: Claws
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) psychic damage.

actions.name: Memory Drain
actions.text: The faceless wanderer drains memories from an adult creature within 30 feet of it. The target must make a DC 13 Intelligence saving throw. On a failure, the target takes 14 (4d6) psychic damage and its Intelligence score is reduced by 1d4. The target dies if this reduces its Intelligence to 0. A humanoid slain in this way rises 1d4 hours later as a new faceless wanderer. Otherwise, the reduction lasts until the target finishes a short or long rest. On a success, the target takes half the damage and its Intelligence score isn't reduced.

actions.name: Prismatic Light (3/Day)

traits.name: 1-4: Arm
traits.text: If the troll has an arm, it loses an arm. It loses one of its claw attacks, and the severed arm can make a claw attack.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The troll has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.text: The troll regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn. If the troll takes acid or fire damage, this trait doesnt function on its next turn. The troll dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesnt regenerate.

traits.name: Severed Limbs
traits.text: If the troll is dealt a critical hit with a slashing weapon, one of its extremities is severed. The extremity has AC 15, 10 hit points, a Speed of 10, and the trolls Regeneration trait. The troll controls the severed extremity and perceives through it with the appropriate senses (for instance, it sees through the eyes of its severed head). As a bonus action, the troll can reattach the extremity. While the troll is missing the extremity, its maximum hit points are reduced by 10. Roll d6 to determine the severed extremity:

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The troll attacks with its bite and twice with its claw. When the troll uses Multiattack  it can use Charming Murmur in place of its bite.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Charming Murmur
actions.text: One creature within 60 feet that can hear the troll makes a DC 12 Charisma saving throw. On a failure  it is charmed for 1 minute. While charmed  its Speed is 0. The creature repeats the saving throw whenever it takes damage.

added.name: Faerie Noble
added.skills: Arcana +7, History +7, Insight +9, Nature +7, Perception +9, Persuasion +9

traits.name: Faerie Form
traits.text: The noble can magically change its size between Large, Medium, and Tiny as an action. While Tiny, the bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage dealt by the nobles attacks is halved. Additionally, it has disadvantage on Strength checks and advantage on Dexterity checks. While Large, the noble has advantage on Strength checks. Its statistics are otherwise unchanged.

traits.name: Faerie Light
traits.text: As a bonus action, the noble can cast dim light for 30 feet, or extinguish its glow.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.text:
The nobles spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 17). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

- **At Will:** Animal Messenger, Detect Evil and Good, Detect Magic, Disguise Self
- **3/Day Each:** Charm Person, Scrying, Zone of Truth,
- **1/Day Each:** Dream, Geas, Heroes Feast, Magic Circle, Polymorph (self only)

actions.name: Evil Eye (Gaze)
actions.text: The noble targets one creature not under the effect of a faeries Evil Eye within 60 feet. The target makes a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed saving throw  the noble chooses one of the following effects to magically impose on the target. Each effect lasts for 1 minute.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The noble makes two glittering scimitar attacks.

actions.name: Glittering Scimitar
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) cold  fire  lightning  or psychic damage (its choice).

actions.name: Gleaming Longbow
actions.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. This attack ignores half or three-quarters cover. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) cold  fire  lightning  or psychic damage (its choice).

actions.name: The target falls asleep
actions.text: This effect ends if the target takes damage or another creature uses an action to rouse it.

actions.name: The target is frightened
actions.text: This effect ends if the target is ever 60 feet or more from the noble.

actions.name: The target is poisoned
actions.text: It can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns  ending the effect on itself on a success.

bonusActions.name: Faerie Step (Recharge 5–6)
bonusActions.text: The noble magically teleports up to 60 feet to a space it can see.

reactions.name: Riposte
reactions.text: When the noble is hit by a melee attack made by a creature it can see, it makes a glittering scimitar attack against the attacker.

reactions.name: Vengeful Eye
reactions.text: When the noble is hit by a ranged attack or targeted with a spell by a creature within 60 feet, it uses Evil Eye on the attacker if they can see each other.

legendaryActions.name: Gleaming Longbow
legendaryActions.text: The faerie noble makes one Gleaming Longbow attack.

legendaryActions.name: Move
legendaryActions.text: The faerie noble moves up to half its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

legendaryActions.name: Evil Eye (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.text:
The faerie noble uses Evil Eye.

The noble targets one creature not under the effect of a faeries Evil Eye within 60 feet. The target makes a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed saving throw  the noble chooses one of the following effects to magically impose on the target. Each effect lasts for 1 minute.

traits.name: Aligned
traits.text: An angel radiates a Lawful aura. Most angels also radiate a Good aura, and a few radiate Evil.

traits.name: Celestial Dissolution
traits.text: When an angel dies, its body and equipment dissolve into motes of light.

traits.name: Detect Alignment
traits.text: An angel knows the alignment, if any, of each creature within 30 feet that it can see.

traits.name: Immortal Nature
traits.text: An angel doesnt require air, sustenance, or sleep.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The deva has advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The deva makes two attacks.

actions.name: Celestial Hammer
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 17 (5d6) radiant damage. On a hit  the target can't make opportunity attacks against the deva until the beginning of the targets next turn.

actions.name: Divine Blast
actions.text: Ranged Spell Attack: +8 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (5d8) radiant damage.

actions.name: Radiant Energy (1/Day)
actions.text: The deva touches a creature other than itself. If the target is unwilling  the deva makes an attack roll with a +8 bonus. The deva can choose to magically heal 60 hit points of damage and end any blindness  curse  deafness  disease  or poison on the target. Alternatively  the deva can choose to deal 60 radiant damage to the target.

actions.name: Change Form
actions.text: The deva magically transforms into a beast or humanoid or back into its true form. It retains its deva statistics  including speech and telepathy  except that it has the size  movement modes  and traits of its new form.

actions.name: Consume Life Energy (1/Day)
actions.text: The angel feasts on the departing life energy of a humanoid within 5 feet. The target must have been slain within the last hour. The angel magically gains temporary hit points equal to half the dead creatures maximum hit points. These hit points last until depleted. Only a spell cast with a 9th-level slot can raise the corpse from the dead.

actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (4d6 + 6) slashing damage plus 21 (6d6) ongoing fire or radiant damage (the planetars choice). A creature can use an action to extinguish this holy flame on itself or a creature within 5 feet.

actions.name: Heavenly Bolt
actions.text: The planetar fires a lightning bolt in a line 100 feet long and 5 feet wide. Each creature in the line makes a Dexterity saving throw  taking 56 (16d6) lightning damage on a failed save  or half damage on a success.

actions.name: Heal (2/Day)

bonusActions.name: Awe-Inspiring Gaze
bonusActions.text: The planetar targets a creature within 90 feet. The target makes a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it is frightened until the end of its next turn. If the target makes its saving throw, it is immune to any angels Awe-Inspiring Gaze for the next 24 hours.

reactions.name: Protective Parry
reactions.text: When a creature within 5 feet would be hit with a melee attack, the planetar applies disadvantage to the attack roll.

legendaryActions.name: Flaming Sword
legendaryActions.text: The fallen planetar makes one Flaming Sword attack.

legendaryActions.name: Move

legendaryActions.name: Crushing Blow (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.text: The fallen planetar makes one Flaming Sword attack with Advantage. On a hit, the target also has the Prone condition if it is Huge or smaller.

added.legendaryActionsIntro: Legendary Action Uses: 3. Immediately after another creature's turn, the fallen planetar can spend a use to take one of these actions. It regains all its uses at the start of each of its turns. _(Added by this site for major monsters; the DM can leave them out.)_

legendaryActions.name: Teleport

legendaryActions.name: Heal (3/Day)

Each creature that succeeds on the saving throw takes 21 (6d6) thunder damage. Each creature that fails its saving throw immediately takes a certain action, depending on the solars command. legendaryActions.name: Abase yourself! The creature falls prone
Approach! The creature must use its reaction
Flee! The creature must use its reaction
Surrender! The creature drops anything it is holding

mythicTrait.name: Mythic Resurgence (1/Day)
mythicTrait.text: If the fallen solar is reduced to 0 Hit Points, it doesn't die or fall Unconscious. Instead it ends every condition on itself and regains 159 Hit Points (half its maximum). Until the end of the fight it can also use the Mythic Actions below.

mythicActions.name: Relentless Holy Sword

added.name: Falsifier Fog
added.resistances: acid, cold, fire, thunder; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
added.immunities: poison; exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, poisoned, prone, restrained, unconscious

traits.name: Enveloping Fog
traits.text: The falsifier fog can occupy another creature’s space and vice versa, and the falsifier fog can move through any opening as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing. The fog’s space is lightly obscured, and a creature in the fog’s space has threequarters cover against attacks and other effects outside the fog.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.text: While the falsifier fog hovers motionlessly, it is indistinguishable from ordinary fog.

traits.name: Horrific Illusions
traits.text: A creature that starts its turn in the falsifier fog’s space must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the start of its next turn, as it sees visions of its worst fears within the fog. While frightened, a creature’s speed is reduced to 0. If a creature fails the saving throw by 5 or more, it is afflicted with short-term madness.

traits.name: Limited Telepathy
traits.text: The falsifier fog can communicate telepathically with any creature in its space.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The falsifier fog makes two chill attacks.

actions.name: Chill
actions.text: Melee Spell Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target in the fog's space. Hit: 10 (3d6) cold damage.

actions.name: Reaching Phantasms (Recharge 5–6)
actions.text: The phantasmal images within the falsifier fog reach outward. Each creature within 10 feet of the fog must make a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw, taking 18 (4d8) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Creatures in the fog's space have disadvantage on the saving throw.

added.name: Fane Spirit
added.resistances: acid, cold, fire, lightning, necrotic, thunder; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks not made with silvered weapons
added.immunities: poison, psychic; charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained
added.languages: any languages it knew in life

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.text: The fane spirit can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.text:
The fane spirit’s innate spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: chill touch, spare the dying
3/day each: cure wounds, inflict wounds, shield of faith
1/day each: augury, hold person, lesser restoration

traits.name: Veil of the Living
traits.text:
During the day a fane spirit appears much as it did in life and loses its Incorporeal Movement trait, its Touch of Forgetfulness action, and its immunity to being grappled and restrained. It retains all other statistics. While in this form, it has a Strength score of 10. If attacked in this form, it relies on its spells to defend itself, but it reverts to its undead form as soon as it takes any damage.

When the sun sets or when it takes any damage, the fane spirit assumes its undead form, and it has all of its listed statistics. Any creature witnessing this transformation must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened until the end of its next turn. A fane spirit reverts to its living form in the morning, though creatures witnessing this don’t need to make saving throws.

actions.name: Touch of Forgetfulness
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) psychic damage. A target hit by this attack must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or forget any or all events that happened up to 5 minutes prior to this attack, as if affected by the modify memory spell. The GM decides how this affects the target.

traits.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
traits.text: The worg has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (3d6 + 3) piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 13) if the worg isn't already grapping a creature. Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained and the worg can't bite another target.

actions.name: Might of the Great Wolf
actions.text:
The fang of the Great Wolf grows in size. This works like the enlarge/reduce spell, except the worg can only enlarge and it lasts for 1 minute. While enlarged, the fang of the Great Wolf gains the following action:
Swallow. The worg makes one bite attack against a Medium or smaller target it is grappling. If the attack hits, the target is also swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the target is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the worg, and it takes 10 (3d6) acid damage at the start of each of the worg's turns. The worg can have only one creature swallowed at a time.

If the worg takes 10 damage or more on a single turn from the swallowed creature, the worg must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate the creature, which falls prone in a space within 5 feet of the worg. The creature is automatically regurgitated when the worg is no longer enlarged. If the worg dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 10 feet of movement, exiting prone.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The far darrig makes two Antler Glaive attacks.

actions.name: Antler Glaive
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) piercing damage or slashing damage (the far darrig's choice) plus 3 (1d6) force damage. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Woodland Friends (1/Day)
actions.text: The far darrig magically calls 1d4 elk or giant weasels. The called Beasts arrive in 1d4 rounds, acting as allies of the far darrig and obeying its spoken commands. The Beasts remain for 1 hour, until the far darrig dies, or until the far darrig dismisses them as a bonus action.

bonusActions.name: Nimble Woodsman
bonusActions.text: The far darrig takes the Dash or Disengage action. The far darrig can use this bonus action only if it is in a forest.

added.name: Far Dorocha
added.ac: 14 (natural armor), 18 while in dim light or darkness)
added.resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.text:
The far dorocha’s innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 15). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components.
At will: disguise self, thaumaturgy
3/day each: command, phantom steed
1/day each: compulsion, darkness

traits.name: Shadow Traveler (3/Day)
traits.text: As a bonus action while in shadows, dim light, or darkness, the far dorocha disappears into the darkness and reappears in an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet. A tendril of inky smoke appears at the origin and destination when it uses this trait.

traits.name: Traveler in Darkness
traits.text: The far dorocha has advantage on Intelligence (Arcana) checks made to know about shadow roads and shadow magic spells or items.

traits.name: Under the Cloak of Night
traits.text: While in dim light or darkness, the far dorocha’s AC includes its Charisma modifier, and it has advantage on saving throws.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The far dorocha makes two dirk attacks.

actions.name: Dirk
actions.text: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Dark Invitation
actions.text:
One humanoid within 30 feet of the far dorocha and that can hear it must succeed on a DC 15 Charisma saving throw or be magically charmed for 1 day. The charmed target believes it has been invited to meet with the far dorocha's master and accompanies the far dorocha. Although the target isn't under the far dorocha's control, it takes the far dorocha's requests or actions in the most favorable way it can. Each time the far dorocha or its companions do anything harmful to the target, the target can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. Otherwise, the effect ends if the far dorocha is destroyed, is on a different plane of existence than the target, or uses its bonus action to end the effect. If the target successfully saves against the effect, or if the effect ends for it, the target is immune to the far dorocha's Dark Invitation for the next 24 hours.

The far dorocha can have only one target charmed at a time. If it charms another, the effect on the previous target ends.

traits.name: Trader
traits.text: The far wanderer understands the literal meaning of any spoken or written language it hears or reads. In addition, it can use an action to read the surface thoughts of one creature within 30 feet. This works like the detect thoughts spell, except it can only read surface thoughts and there is no limit to the duration. It can end this effect as a bonus action or by using an action to change the target.

traits.name: Traveler
traits.text: As a bonus action, the far wanderer folds the fabric of reality to teleport itself to an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet. A brief shimmer of starlight appears at the origin and destination.

actions.name: Stardust Blade
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d8 + 2) slashing damage and 2 (1d4) cold damage.

actions.name: Stardust bow
actions.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage and 2 (1d4) cold damage.

actions.name: Call to Yorama (1/Day)
actions.text: The far wanderer channels the energy of the living god-star Yorama. One creature the far wanderer can see within 60 feet must make a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw, taking 7 (2d6) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature who fails the saving throw is stunned until the end of its turn. Alternately, the far wanderer can instead restore 14 (4d6) hp to one willing creature it can see within 60 feet.

added.name: Fate Eater
added.languages: understands all but can't speak, telepathy 100 ft.

traits.name: Visionary Flesh
traits.text: A creature that eats the flesh of a fate eater must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the creature is poisoned for 1 hour. On a success, the creature gains the benefits of the divination spell.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The fate eater makes two Bite attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Alter Fate (Recharge 5–6)
actions.text: The fate eater alters the fate of one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The creature must make a DC 15 Charisma saving throw. On a failure, the creature takes 36 (8d8) psychic damage, and its fate is altered. Roll a d6 to determine which of the following alterations affects the creature. On a success, the creature takes half the damage, and its fate isn't altered. A creature with an altered fate for 1 minute or less can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. Otherwise, a creature with an altered fate can repeat the saving throw at the end of each long rest, ending the effect on itself on a success.

added.name: Faux-Garou
added.immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned
added.languages: understands creator's languages but can't speak

traits.name: Construct Nature
traits.text: Doesn’t require air food drink or sleep.

traits.name: Druidic Vengeance
traits.text: Knows scent and appearance of each creature it was created to kill. Advantage on attacks vs. such creatures and on Wis (Perception) and Wis (Survival) checks to find and track them.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.text: Immune: form-altering spells/effects.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: Advantage: spell/magic effect saves.

traits.name: Necrotic Weapons
traits.text: Weapon attacks are magical. When it hits with any weapon deals extra 3d6 necrotic (included below).

bonusActions.name: Change Shape
bonusActions.text: Transforms into Large or smaller Beast matching type of lycanthrope it resembles (wolf if it resembles a werewolf etc.) or back into its true form. Its stats other than size and speed are same in each form. While transformed retains constructed appearance and claws at end of its forelimbs. Items worn or carried not transformed. Reverts to true form if it dies.

added.name: Fear Liath
added.languages: any languages it knew in life

traits.name: Gray Curse
traits.text: If remove curse is cast upon a fear liath, it is instantly destroyed. In addition, if the fear liath kills a humanoid creature, the fear liath is destroyed and the humanoid it killed rises as a fear liath in 1d4 hours. If remove curse is cast upon the cursed humanoid before it becomes a fear liath, the curse is broken.

traits.name: Unwatchable
traits.text:
The fear liath becomes incorporeal and appears as a dark gray shadow while any living creature looks directly at it. While incorporeal, it can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object. While incorporeal, it also gains resistance to acid, fire, lightning, and thunder damage, and bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks. The fear liath has no control over this trait.

Unless surprised, a creature can avert its eyes to avoid looking directly at the fear liath at the start of its turn. If the creature does so, it can't see the fear liath until the start of its next turn, when it can avert its eyes again. If a creature looks at the fear liath, the fear liath becomes incorporeal.

actions.name: Slam
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be blinded for 1 minute. It can repeat this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

added.name: Fear Smith
added.resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from attacks not made with cold iron weapons

traits.name: Distortion Gaze
traits.text: Those who meet the gaze of the fear smith experience the world seeming to twist at unnatural angles beneath their feet. When a creature that can see the fear smith’s eye starts its turn within 30 feet of the fear smith, the fear smith can force the creature to make a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw if the fear smith isn’t incapacitated and can see the creature. On a failed save, the creature is disoriented until the start of its next turn. While disoriented, a creature can’t take the Dash or Disengage action, and when it moves for the first time on its turn, it must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or fall prone.

traits.name: Hidden Eye
traits.text: The fear smith has advantage on saving throws against being blinded.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The fear smith has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The fear smith makes three Claw attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Heart-Stopping Stare.

actions.name: Claw
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) psychic damage. If the target is disoriented by Distortion Gaze, the fear smith regains hp equal to the amount of psychic damage dealt.

actions.name: Heart-Stopping Stare
actions.text: The fear smith terrifies a creature within 30 feet of it with a look. The target must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or take 13 (3d8) psychic damage and be stunned until the end of its next turn. The fear smith regains hp equal to the psychic damage dealt.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.text:
The fear smith casts one of the following spells, requiring no verbal or material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 16):

- **At Will:** detect thoughts, fear
- **2/Day Each:** charm person, command

added.name: Felid Dragon
added.senses: Blindsight 60 ft., Darkvision 120 ft.; Passive Perception 13

traits.name: Flyby
traits.text: The felid dragon doesn’t provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy’s reach.

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.text: The felid dragon has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The felid dragon has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Pounce
traits.text: If the felid dragon moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 20 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the felid dragon can make one bite attack against it as a bonus action.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The felid dragon can use its Deafening Roar. It then makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (2d10 + 8) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d6 + 8) slashing damage, and, if the target is a creature other than an undead or a construct, it must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw or take 2 (1d4) slashing damage at the start of each of its turns as a piece of the claw breaks off in the wound. Each time the dragon hits the target with this attack, the damage dealt by the wound each round increases by 3 (1d6). Any creature can take an action to remove the claw with a successful DC 16 Wisdom (Medicine) check. The claw pops out of the wound if the target receives magical healing.

actions.name: Deafening Roar
actions.text: Each creature within 60 feet of the dragon and that can hear it must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or be deafened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the dragon's Deafening Roar for the next 24 hours.

actions.name: Sickening Bile (Recharge 5–6)
actions.text: The dragon coughs up partially digested food and slimy bile in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 20 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 70 (20d6) poison damage and is coated in bile. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't coated in bile. While coated in bile, a creature is poisoned. A creature, including the target coated in bile, can use its action to remove the bile, ending the poisoned condition.

legendaryActions.name: Bite
legendaryActions.text: The felid dragon makes one Bite attack.

legendaryActions.name: Move
legendaryActions.text: The felid dragon moves up to half its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

legendaryActions.name: Deafening Roar (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.text:
The felid dragon uses Deafening Roar.

Each creature within 60 feet of the dragon and that can hear it must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or be deafened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the dragon's Deafening Roar for the next 24 hours.

added.legendaryActionsIntro: Legendary Action Uses: 3. Immediately after another creature's turn, the felid dragon can spend a use to take one of these actions. It regains all its uses at the start of each of its turns. _(Added by this site for major monsters; the DM can leave them out.)_

mythicTrait.name: Mythic Resurgence (1/Day)
mythicTrait.text: If the felid dragon is reduced to 0 Hit Points, it doesn't die or fall Unconscious. Instead it ends every condition on itself and regains 137 Hit Points (half its maximum). Until the end of the fight it can also use the Mythic Actions below.

mythicActions.name: Relentless Bite
mythicActions.text: The felid dragon makes two Bite attacks.

mythicActions.name: Unleashed Deafening Roar (Costs 2 Actions)
mythicActions.text:
The felid dragon uses Deafening Roar, even if it isn't recharged or has no uses left.

Each creature within 60 feet of the dragon and that can hear it must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or be deafened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the dragon's Deafening Roar for the next 24 hours.

mythicActions.name: Shrug It Off
mythicActions.text: The felid dragon ends one condition on itself and gains 28 Temporary Hit Points.

mythicActions.name: Terrible Presence (Costs 2 Actions)
mythicActions.text: _Wisdom Saving Throw:_ DC 18, each enemy within 30 feet that can see the felid dragon. _Failure:_ The target has the Frightened condition until the end of its next turn.

mythicActions.name: Sweep Aside
mythicActions.text: _Strength Saving Throw:_ DC 22, each creature within 10 feet of the felid dragon. _Failure:_ The target is pushed up to 10 feet away and has the Prone condition.

added.mythicActionsIntro: Once Mythic Resurgence has been used, the felid dragon can spend its Legendary Action uses on these options too. _(Added by this site; the DM can leave them out.)_

added.name: Fell Nightmare
added.languages: understands Abyssal, Common, and Infernal but can't speak

traits.name: Evil
traits.text: The nightmare radiates an Evil aura.

traits.name: Fiery Hooves
traits.text: The nightmare sheds bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet. The nightmare leaves charred hoofprints.

traits.name: Fiery Trail
traits.text: When the nightmare moves along the ground, it can choose to leave behind a trail of fire 10 feet wide and 10 feet tall, which lasts until the beginning of the nightmares next turn. A creature that begins its turn in the fire or enters it for the first time on a turn takes 10 (3d6) fire damage. The trail ignites flammable objects.

traits.name: Fire Resistance
traits.text: The nightmare can grant fire resistance to a rider.

traits.name: Telepathy
traits.text: The nightmare gains telepathy with a range of 120 feet. It can telepathically communicate with the fiend that trained it over any distance as long as they are on the same plane of existence.

actions.name: Hooves
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage. If the horse moves at least 20 feet straight towards the target before the attack  the target makes a DC 14 Strength saving throw  falling prone on a failure. The nightmare can move through the space of a prone creature as long as it does not end its turn there.

actions.name: Ethereal Shift (Recharge 5–6)
actions.text: The nightmare and a rider magically pass from the Ethereal Plane to the Material Plane or vice versa.

added.name: Fellforged
added.immunities: necrotic, poison, psychic; charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned
added.languages: the languages it knew in life

traits.name: Construct Nature
traits.text: The fellforged doesn’t require air, food, drink, or sleep.

traits.name: Inhabiting Spirit
traits.text: The fellforged is inhabited and animated by a specter. If the fellforged fails a saving throw against an effect that turns undead, the specter is expelled into an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the fellforged with the hp total it had before it was expelled. The specter otherwise uses the statistics of a specter.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.text: While in sunlight, the fellforged has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The fellforged makes two Necrotic Slam attacks.

actions.name: Necrotic Slam
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or its hp maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hp maximum to 0.

bonusActions.name: Burst Gears
bonusActions.text: The specter within the fellforged strains the construct's body, sending broken springs and gears flying. Each creature within 5 feet of the fellforged must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw, taking 7 (2d6) piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Each time the fellforged uses this bonus action, its speed is reduced by 5 feet, and it can't use this bonus action if its speed is 0. Its speed returns to normal when it finishes a long rest.

traits.name: Keen Hearing and Sight
traits.text: The fennec fox has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or sight.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) piercing damage.

traits.name: Fey Resilience
traits.text: The feral hunter is resistant to the charmed and unconscious conditions.

traits.name: Heightened Senses
traits.text: The feral hunter's Perception is 19 when perceiving by sight, hearing, or smell.

traits.name: Precise
traits.text: A weapon that deals piercing damage deals one extra die of its damage when the feral hunter hits with it (included in the attack).

traits.name: Woodland Walk
traits.text: Difficult terrain composed of nonmagical plants doesn't cost the feral hunter extra movement. In addition, the feral hunter can pass through nonmagical plants without being slowed by them and without taking damage from them if they have thorns, spines, or a similar hazard.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The feral hunter makes two Hunting Knife or Longbow attacks.

actions.name: Hunting Knife
actions.text: _Melee Weapon Attack:_ +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. _Hit:_ 10 (2d6+3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.text: _Ranged Weapon Attack:_ +5 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. _Hit:_ 12 (2d8+3) piercing damage.

bonusActions.name: Mark Quarry
bonusActions.text: The feral hunter marks one creature it can see within 30 feet of it as its quarry until the start of the feral hunter's next turn. When the feral hunter hits the marked creature with a weapon attack, the weapon deals an extra 1d6 damage of the weapon's type to the target.

reactions.name: Reposition
reactions.text: When the feral hunter takes damage, it can move up to 10 feet without provoking opportunity attacks.

traits.name: Enchanted Cage
traits.text: The savant is immune to damage and can’t be the target of spells or effects as long as its cage exists. The cage has a flying speed of 30 feet while the savant is inside of it, moving at the mental command of the savant. When the cage is destroyed, the savant floats gently to the ground. The cage has AC 19, 75 hp, and is immune to piercing, poison, and psychic damage. A non-derro that touches the cage or hits it with a melee weapon attack while within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or take 7 (2d6) psychic damage and be frightened until the end of its next turn. The cage disintegrates if exposed to sunlight for 1 hour.

traits.name: Maddening Babble
traits.text: The savant constantly babbles eldritch nonsense while it can see any non-derro creatures and isn’t incapacitated. Each non-derro creature that starts its turn within 20 feet of the savant and can hear the babbling must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be incapacitated until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Sunlight Hypersensitivity
traits.text: The savant takes 20 radiant damage when it starts its turn outside the cage and in sunlight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The fetal savant makes two Psychic Burst attacks.

actions.name: Psychic Burst
actions.text: Melee or Ranged Spell Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) psychic damage.

actions.name: Soul Exchange (Recharge 6)
actions.text: The savant exchanges its soul with one Humanoid it can see within 20 feet of it. Its body becomes paralyzed, the target's soul inhabits the savant's paralyzed body, and the savant inhabits the target's body, taking full control of it. The savant retains its alignment, its Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores, its Psychic Burst action, and its immunity to being charmed and frightened. It otherwise uses the target's statistics, but doesn't gain access to the target's knowledge, class features, or proficiencies.

added.name: Fext
added.resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
added.immunities: poison; charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned
added.senses: Darkvision 60 ft., Truesight 20 ft.; Passive Perception 14
added.languages: the languages it knew in life

traits.name: Eldritch Weapons
traits.text: The fext’s weapon attacks are magical. When the fext hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 2d8 force damage (included in the attack).

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The fext has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Patron’s Blessing
traits.text: While the fext is conscious and wearing no armor and wielding no shield, it adds its Charisma modifier to its AC (included above).

traits.name: Undead Nature
traits.text: The fext doesn’t require air, food, drink, or sleep.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The fext makes two Eldritch Blade or Eldritch Fury attacks.

actions.name: Eldritch Blade
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) force damage.

actions.name: Eldritch Fury
actions.text: Ranged Spell Attack: +7 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (3d8 + 4) force damage.

actions.name: Patron's Might (Recharge 5–6)
actions.text: The fext channels its patron's awe-inspiring presence, terrifying those nearby. Each creature within 10 feet of the fext must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 35 (10d6) psychic damage and is frightened for 1 minute. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't frightened. A frightened creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.text:
The fey drake's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks). The fey drake can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components
At will: charm person, color spray, grease
3/day each: hypnotic pattern, locate creature, suggestion
1/day each: dominate person, polymorph

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The fey drake has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Superior Invisibility
traits.text: As a bonus action, the fey drake can magically turn invisible until its concentration ends (as if concentrating on a spell). Any equipment the drake wears or carries is invisible with it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The fey drake makes three bite attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d4 + 5) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 hour.

actions.name: Bewildering Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.text: The drake breaths a plume of purple gas in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed for 1 minute. While charmed, the creature can't take bonus actions or reactions, and it makes all Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma skill checks and saving throws with disadvantage.

traits.name: Faerie Form
traits.text: The knight can magically change its size between Medium and Tiny as an action. While tiny, the bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage dealt by the knights attacks is halved. Additionally, it has disadvantage on Strength checks and advantage on Dexterity checks. Its statistics are otherwise unchanged.

traits.name: Faerie Light
traits.text: As a bonus action, the knight can cast dim light for 30 feet, or extinguish its glow.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The knight makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Glittering Scimitar
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) cold  fire  or lightning damage (its choice).

actions.name: Longbow
actions.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) poison damage. If the poison damage reduces the target to 0 hit points  the target is stable but poisoned for 1 hour  even if it regains hit points  and it is asleep while poisoned in this way.

actions.name: Fey Glamour
actions.text: The knight targets one humanoid within 30 feet. The target makes a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure  it is magically charmed by the knight for 1 day. If the knight or one of the knights allies harms the target  the target repeats the saving throw  ending the effect on itself on a success. If a targets saving throw is successful  or if the effect ends for it  the creature is immune to this knights Fey Charm for a year and a day.

reactions.name: Natures Shield
reactions.text: When the knight would be hit by an attack while the knight is within 5 feet of a tree or other large plant, the knights AC magically increases by 3 against that attack as the plant interposes branches or vines between the knight and the attacker.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The fey revenant has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Shadow Sight
traits.text: Magical darkness doesn’t impede the fey revenant’s darkvision.

traits.name: Shadow Traveler (4/Day)
traits.text: As a bonus action while in shadows, dim light, or darkness, the fey revenant disappears into the darkness and reappears in an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet. A tendril of inky smoke appears at its origin and destination when it uses this trait.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.text: The fey revenant can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.text: While in sunlight, the fey revenant has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

traits.name: Thorn Body
traits.text: A creature that touches the fey revenant or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 4 (1d8) piercing damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The fey revenant makes three attacks, either with its shortsword or longbow. It can use its Queen's Grasp in place of one shortsword or longbow attack.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, range 120/600 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Queen's Grasp
actions.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, ranged 30/60 ft., one target. Hit: The target is restrained by icy wisps of shadow. While restrained, the creature takes 7 (2d6) cold damage at the start of each of its turns. As an action, the restrained creature can make a DC 15 Strength check, bursting through the icy shadow on a success. The icy shadow can also be attacked and destroyed (AC 10; 5 hp; resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage; immunity to cold, necrotic, poison, and psychic damage).

added.name: Feyward Tree
added.resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks not made with adamantine weapons
added.immunities: lightning, poison, psychic; charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned
added.languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

traits.name: Aversion to Cold
traits.text: If the feyward tree takes cold damage, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and its speed is halved until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Construct Nature
traits.text: The feyward tree doesn’t require air, food, drink, or sleep.

traits.name: Enchanted Leaves
traits.text: The feyward tree’s Razor-Leafed Branch attacks are magical. When the tree hits with its Razor-Leafed Branch, the branch deals an extra 9 (2d8) force damage (included in the attack).

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.text: The feyward tree is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Lightning Absorption
traits.text: Whenever the feyward tree is subjected to lightning damage, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of hp equal to the lightning damage dealt.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The feyward tree has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Warden’s Reach
traits.text: A creature within 15 feet of a feyward tree that moves away from it provokes an opportunity attack even if the creature takes the Disengage action.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The feyward tree makes two Razor-Leafed Branch attacks.

actions.name: Razor-Leafed Branch
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d8 + 7) slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) force damage.

actions.name: Flaying Leaves (Recharge 5–6)
actions.text: The feyward tree launches a barrage of razor-sharp cold iron leaves from its branches. Each creature within 20 feet of the tree must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 28 (8d6) slashing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

added.name: Fidele Angel
added.resistances: fire, lightning, poison; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks
added.immunities: acid, cold; charmed, exhaustion, petrified, poisoned

traits.name: Ever Connected
traits.text: Fidele angels are magically connected. Damage taken by the fidele angel is split evenly between the fidele angel and its paired fidele angel. The angel that was the original target of the attack takes any damage that won’t divide evenly. All other effects, such as reducing ability scores or being the target of a bless spell, affect only the target.

traits.name: Immortal Nature
traits.text: The fidele angel doesn’t require food, drink, or sleep.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The angel has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.text: The angel’s weapon attacks are magical.

traits.name: Unshakeable Fidelity
traits.text: No spell, feature, trait, magic, or other effect can cause a fidele angel to act against or harm its mate or change its love or loyalty toward its mate.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The fidele angel makes three Longsword or Radiant Bolt attacks. Alternatively, it makes one Beak attack and two Talons attacks.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) slashing damage, or 10 (1d10 + 5) slashing damage if used with two hands.

actions.name: Beak
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Talons
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage.

actions.name: Radiant Bolt
actions.text: Ranged Spell Attack: +7 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) radiant damage.

actions.name: To My Lover's Side
actions.text: If its mate is more than 1 mile away from it, the fidele angel can magically teleport, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, to an unoccupied space within 10 feet of its mate. The angel can use this action even if its mate is on another plane of existence.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.text:
The angel casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as its spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15):

- **At Will:** detect evil and good, purify food and drink, spare the dying
- **3/Day Each:** bless, cure wounds, daylight

bonusActions.name: Change Shape
bonusActions.text: The fidele angel transforms into a Medium or smaller Humanoid, a Large or smaller birdlike Beast, or back into its true form, which is a winged Celestial. Without wings, it loses its flying speed. Its statistics, other than its size and speed, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

added.name: Fierstjerren
added.immunities: necrotic, poison; charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned, unconscious

traits.name: Apotheosis
traits.text: When the fierstjerren has 80 hp or fewer, the spirit within it tears free and tendrils of necrotic energy erupt from its skin. When it hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 4 (1d8) necrotic damage. When it has 60 hp or fewer, its weapon attacks instead deal an extra 9 (2d8) necrotic damage. When it has 40 hp or fewer, its weapon attacks instead deal an extra 13 (3d8) necrotic damage.

traits.name: Thrall Watch
traits.text: A fierstjerren with thralls can't be surprised and attacks from hiding don't gain advantage against it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The fierstjerren makes two sword attacks.

actions.name: Sword
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Terrifying Glare
actions.text: The fierstjerren targets one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. If the creature can see the fierstjerren, it must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of the fierstjerren's next turn.

actions.name: Thrall Enslavement
actions.text: The fierstjerren targets one humanoid it can see within 30 feet of it that has a CR up to 1/2. The humanoid must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be magically charmed by the fierstjerren. The fierstjerren can telepathically communicate with any creature it has charmed. The charmed target can't take reactions and obeys the fierstjerren's verbal and telepathic commands. A fierstjerren can have up to twelve charmed thralls at one time. A charmed thrall loses the memories of its previous life and devotes itself to the fierstjerren and the cult. The charm lasts for 24 hours or until the fierstjerren is destroyed, is more than 300 feet from the charmed target, or takes a bonus action to end the effect. The fierstjerren can attempt to reassert control over all of its thralls by using this action. Each thrall can repeat the saving throw when the fierstjerren uses this action to reassert control.

added.name: Fire Dancer Swarm
added.immunities: fire, poison; exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, stunned, unconscious

traits.name: Fire Form
traits.text: A creature that touches the swarm or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 5 (1d10) fire damage. In addition, the first time the swarm enters a creature's space on a turn, that creature takes 5 (1d10) fire damage and catches fire; until someone uses an action to douse the fire, the creature takes 5 (1d10) fire damage at the start of each of its turns.

traits.name: Illumination
traits.text: The swarm sheds bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light to an additional 30 feet.

traits.name: Swarm
traits.text: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny creature. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

traits.name: Water Susceptibility
traits.text: For every 5 feet the swarm moves in water, or for every gallon of water splashed on it, it takes 1 cold damage.

actions.name: Swarm
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target in the swarm's space. Hit: 21 (6d6) fire damage, or 10 (3d6) fire damage if the swarm has half or fewer hit points.

added.name: Fire Giant War Priest

traits.name: Cold Weakness
traits.text: When the fire giant takes cold damage, its speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The giant makes two greatsword attacks.

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 28 (6d6 + 7) slashing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature  it makes a DC 19 Strength saving throw. On a failure  it is pushed up to 10 feet away from the giant and knocked prone.

actions.name: Rock
actions.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. Hit: 42 (10d6 + 7) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature  it makes a DC 19 Strength saving throw  falling prone on a failure.

actions.name: Sword Sweep (1/Day)
