actions.text: Each creature within 15 ft. of the duskwilt and that isn't a Construct or Undead must make a DC 14 Con save. On a failure a creature takes 15 (6d4) poison and is poisoned for 1 min. On a success a creature takes half the damage and isn't poisoned. The poisoned creature can re-save at end of each of its turns success ends effect on itself. In addition each Undead within 15 ft. of the duskwilt gains 7 (2d6) temp hp.

traits.name: Central Stalk Weakness
traits.text: When exposed central stalk can be attacked and destroyed (AC 13; hp 50; vulnerability to acid cold and fire). If central stalk is destroyed mulcher has disadvantage on attacks and can’t use Expose Stalk until it regrows one at end of next long rest.

traits.name: Disturbed Soil (Exposed Stalk Only)
traits.text: Ground within 20' is difficult.

traits.name: Mulcher Pit
traits.text: If it burrows 20'+ straight toward a creature can dig 10 ft. diameter 20' deep pit beneath it. Each Large or smaller creature in pit’s area: fall into mycelium-lined pit and land prone taking 14 (4d6) piercing damage from spiked mycelium + fall damage (DC 15 Dex doesn't fall). Can make one Mycelium Spike vs. prone creature in pit as bonus action.

traits.name: Stalk Regeneration (Exposed Stalk Only)
traits.text: Gains 15 hp at start of its turn if it has at least 1 hp.

bonusActions.name: Expose Stalk
bonusActions.text: Exposes central stalk above ground until end of its next turn or until it ends effect as bonus action. If exposed can't burrow.

bonusActions.name: Rapid Burrow
bonusActions.text: Burrows up to 60 feet. Opportunity attacks vs. it are made with disadvantage when mulcher burrows out of an enemy's reach this way. Creatures grappled by it are freed before it burrows.

reactions.name: Emergent Stalk
reactions.text: When reduced below half hp max or creature scores critical hit vs. it immediately uses Expose Stalk.

added.name: Fungi, Mush Marcher
added.languages: understands Common, + one language known by its grower, but can't speak

traits.name: Keen Hearing
traits.text: Advantage on hearing Wis (Perception) checks.

traits.name: Partial Echolocation
traits.text: Its blindsight is reduced to 10 ft. while deafened.

bonusActions.name: Recall Harpoon
bonusActions.text: Pulls on the mycelial threads connecting it to its harpoon returning the harpoon to its empty hand. If harpoon is stuck in a creature that creature must make DC 13 Str save or be pulled up to 15 ft. toward marcher.

added.name: Fungi, Void Fungus
added.immunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, poisoned
added.languages: understands Common and Void Speech but can't speak, telepathy 60'

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.text: While motionless indistinguishable from patch of glowing fungus.

traits.name: Illumination
traits.text: Sheds dim light in a 10 ft. radius.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: 2 Poisonous Mycelium or Psychic Blasts. If it hits one creature with both Blasts target charmed 1 min (DC 13 Cha negates) and can re-save at end of each of its turns success ends effect on itself.

actions.name: Poisonous Mycelium
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 6 (1d8+2) piercing damage + 7 (2d6) poison and poisoned until end of its next turn (DC 13 Con not poisoned.)

actions.name: Psychic Blast
actions.text: Ranged Spell Attack: +5 to hit, 60 ft., one target, 12 (2d8+3) psychic.

actions.name: Consume Energy
actions.text: Hair-like tendrils dangling from its cap flash as it draws psychic energy from creature it can see within 30' of it. Target 18 (4d8) psychic (DC 13 Cha half). Fungus regains equal hp.

added.name: Gaki
added.resistances: acid, fire, lightning, thunder; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
added.immunities: cold, necrotic, poison; charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained
added.languages: any languages it knew in life

traits.name: Aura of Famine
traits.text: If a creature starts its turn within 10 feet of a gaki, it is overwhelmed by a hunger that dissolves fat and atrophies muscle. It must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw, taking 11 (2d10) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

traits.name: Gluttonous Attraction
traits.text: At the start of its turn, if a creature can see the gaki, it must make a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it is overcome with a desire to kill and eat the ghost, and it must move as close to the gaki as it can.

traits.name: Hungry Frenzy
traits.text: The gaki has advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its hp.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.text: The gaki can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The gaki makes two bite attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) acid damage.

actions.name: Spit Acid
actions.text: Ranged Spell Attack: +6 to hit, range 30 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (6d6) acid damage.

added.name: Galidroo
added.resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Aura of Lassitude
traits.text: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the galidroo must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or feel lethargic until the start of its next turn. While lethargic, a creature can’t use reactions, its speed is halved, and it can’t make more than one melee or ranged attack on its turn. In addition, the creature can use either an action or a bonus action on its turn, but not both. On a successful saving throw, the creature is immune to the galidroo’s Aura of Lassitude for the next 24 hours.

traits.name: Selective Precognition
traits.text: The galidroo can see into the past, present, and future simultaneously. It can innately cast divination and legend lore once per day each, requiring no material components. Its innate spellcasting ability is Wisdom. The galidroo can’t use these spells to gain information about itself or its personal future or past.

traits.name: Two-Headed
traits.text: The galidroo has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks and on saving throws against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, and knocked unconscious.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The galidroo makes four attacks: two with its bite and two with its claws. It can make one tail attack in place of its two claw attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) slashing damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (3d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage. The target is grappled (escape DC 17) if it is a Large or smaller creature and the galidroo doesn't have another creature grappled. Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the galidroo can't use its tail on another target.

actions.name: Prophetic Screech (Recharge 5–6)
actions.text: The galidroo unleashes a burst of prophetic power in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 17 Intelligence saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 35 (10d6) psychic damage and is incapacitated for 1 minute as its mind is bombarded with visions of its past and future. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't incapacitated. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

legendaryActions.name: Bite
legendaryActions.text: The galidroo makes one Bite attack.

legendaryActions.name: Move
legendaryActions.text: The galidroo moves up to half its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

legendaryActions.name: Crushing Blow (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.text: The galidroo makes one Bite attack with Advantage. On a hit, the target also has the Prone condition if it is Huge or smaller.

added.legendaryActionsIntro: Legendary Action Uses: 3. Immediately after another creature's turn, the galidroo can spend a use to take one of these actions. It regains all its uses at the start of each of its turns. _(Added by this site for major monsters; the DM can leave them out.)_

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.text: The gargoctopus can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Shifting Camouflage
traits.text: The gargoctopus has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.text: The gargoctopus can climb on difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The gargoctopus makes four tentacle attacks or one bite attack and three tentacle attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (3d8 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 15). Until the grapple ends, the target is restrained, the gargoctopus can automatically hit the target with its tentacle, and it can't use the same tentacle on another target. The gargoctopus can grapple up to four creatures at one time.

actions.name: Fling
actions.text: One Medium or smaller creature grappled by the gargoctopus is thrown up to 20 feet in a random direction and is knocked prone. If the target strikes a solid surface, the target takes 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage. If the target is thrown at another creature, that creature must succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw or take the same damage and be knocked prone.

actions.name: Tentacle Slam (Recharge 5–6)
actions.text: The gargoctopus slams the creatures grappled by it into a solid surface. Each grappled creature must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a target takes 10 (3d6) bludgeoning damage and is stunned until the end of the gargoctopus' next turn. On a success, a target takes half the damage and isn't stunned.

actions.name: Ink Cloud (Recharge 6)
actions.text: A 20-foot-radius cloud of darkness extends around the gargoctopus. The area is heavily obscured until the start of the gargoctopus' next turn. If underwater, the gargoctopus can use the Dash action as a bonus action after releasing the cloud.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.text:
The garlicle’s innate spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 14). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: guidance, shillelagh
3/day: augury, comprehend languages
1/day: divination, entangle

traits.name: Plant Camouflage
traits.text: The garlicle has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks it makes in any terrain with ample obscuring plant life.

traits.name: Tearful Stench
traits.text: Each creature other than an alliumite or garlicle within 5 feet of the garlicle when it takes damage must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the start of the creature’s next turn. On a successful saving throw, the creature is immune to the Tearful Stench of all alliumites and garlicles for 1 minute.

actions.name: Walking Staff
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +0 to hit (+6 to hit with shillelagh), reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 (1d6 - 2) bludgeoning damage, 2 (1d8 - 2) bludgeoning damage if wielded with two hands, or 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage with shillelagh.

actions.name: Cloves of Fate (Recharge 4–6)
actions.text:
The garlicle plucks cloves from its head and throws them at up to three creatures it can see within 30 feet of it. Roll a d4 for each creature. The garlicles allies have +1 on the roll while its enemies have a -1 on the roll. Determine the result and consult the following table.

| d4 | Fate |
|----|------|
| 0 | Worst Fortune. Whatever the target is holding slips from its grasp into a random space within 5 feet of the target, and the target falls prone as it trips over a rock, rain-dampened grass, its shoelaces, or similar. |
| 1 | Bad Fortune. The target takes 10 (3d6) poison damage and must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the end of its next turn. |
| 2 | Adverse Fortune. The target has disadvantage on its next attack roll. |
| 3 | Favorable Fortune. The target has advantage on its next attack roll. |
| 4 | Good Fortune. The target regains 5 (2d4) hp. |
| 5 | Best Fortune. The target's next successful hit is critical. |

traits.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
traits.text: Has advantage on Wis (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

traits.name: Multiple Heads
traits.text: Has three heads. While it has more than one head it has advantage on saves vs. being blinded charmed deafened frightened stunned and knocked unconscious. Whenever it takes 25 or more damage in a single turn one head dies. If all its heads die it dies. At the end of its turn it grows two heads for each head that died since its last turn unless it has taken fire since its last turn. Regains 10 hp for each head regrown in this way.

traits.name: Trampling Charge
traits.text: If it moves 20'+ straight toward creature and then hits it with Bite on same turn target must make a DC 16 Str save or be knocked prone. If target is prone garmvvolf can make one Bite vs. it as a bonus action.

traits.name: Wakeful
traits.text: While it sleeps at least one of its heads is awake.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Makes as many Bite attacks as it has heads.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, 10 ft., one target, 8 (1d6+5) piercing damage + 10 (3d6) poison.

actions.name: Tripartite Howl (Recharge 5-6)
actions.text: Its heads exhale a three-part howl one filled with poisonous spittle one a thunderous bellow and one a frightful bay in a 30' cone. Each creature in area: 17 (5d6) poison and 17 (5d6) thunder and becomes frightened 1 min (DC 16 Dex half damage isn't frightened). A frightened creature can re-save at end of each of its turns ending effect on itself on a success.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.text: The garroter crab can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Strangling Divination
traits.text: A Humanoid reduced to 0 hp while grappled by the garroter crab experiences a brief vision of the future. This effect works like the divination spell, except the reply is only as a mental vision and it can be about any specific goal, event, or activity to occur within 30 days. Once a creature has received a vision in this way, it can’t do so again for 30 days.

actions.name: Whip-Claw
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 12). Until this grapple ends, the target can't speak or cast spells with verbal components, and the crab can't use its Whip Claw on another target.

traits.name: Keen Hearing
traits.text: The gaunt one has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The gaunt one makes two claw attacks. If both attacks hit a Medium or smaller target, the target is grappled (escape DC 14).

actions.name: Claw
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Extract Heart
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one humanoid grappled by the gaunt one. Hit: The target must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw, taking 22 (5d8) piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If this damage reduces the target to 0 hp, the gaunt one kills the target by extracting and devouring its heart.

traits.name: Shifting Camouflage
traits.text: The gbahali’s hide adapts to its current surroundings. The gbahali has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in nonmagical, natural terrain.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The gbahali makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack:+7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 15). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the gbahali can't Bite another target.

actions.name: Claw
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage.

traits.name: Chameleon Hide
traits.text: The gbahali has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks. If the gbahali moves one-half its speed or less, attacks made against it before the start of the gbahali's next turn have disadvantage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The gbahali makes one bite attack and two claw attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 24 (3d12 + 5) piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 15). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the gbahali can't bite another target.

actions.name: Claw
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage.

added.name: Gear Spider
added.immunities: poison, psychic; blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned

traits.name: Clockwork Nature
traits.text: A clockwork doesnt require air, nourishment, or rest, and is immune to disease.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.text: The clockwork is immune to any effect that would alter its form.

actions.name: Claw
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +0 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 slashing damage.

actions.name: Needle
actions.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

bonusActions.name: Photograph
bonusActions.text: The gear spider stores a black and white image of what it can see. The gear spider can hold up to 10 images at a time. Retrieving the image storage device inside the gear spider requires 1 minute. Once the device is accessed, viewing a stored image requires a DC 12 Investigation check to make out any details.

added.name: Gearforged Templar
added.resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
added.immunities: poison, psychic; charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned

traits.name: Construct Nature
traits.text: The gearforged templar doesn’t require air, food, drink, or sleep.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The gearforged templar makes four Greatsword or Javelin attacks. If two Greatsword attacks hit one creature, the target must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 10 feet away from the templar. The templar can choose not to push a creature.

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage

actions.name: Javelin
actions.text: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Whirlwind (Recharge 5–6)
actions.text: The gearforged templar whirls its greatsword in a great arc. Each creature within 10 feet of the gearforged must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 27 (5d10) slashing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

reactions.name: Defensive Zone
reactions.text: When a creature enters the gearforged templar's reach, the templar makes one Greatsword attack against the creature.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.text: The gearforged templar adds 3 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it. To do so, the templar must be able to see the attacker and must be wielding a melee weapon.

added.name: Gearmass
added.immunities: acid, fire; blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, prone

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.text: Move through space 1ft.+ wide with o squeezing.

traits.name: Clanging Mass
traits.text: Is filled with metal objects that clang scrape and clink together as it moves. When it moves it has disadvantage on Dex (Stealth) checks to stay silent until start of its next turn.

traits.name: Ooze Nature
traits.text: Doesn’t require sleep.

traits.name: Rust Metal
traits.text: Any nonmagic metal weapon that hits gearmass corrodes. After dealing damage weapon: permanent cumulative –1 penalty to damage. If penalty drops to –5 destroyed. Nonmagic metal ammo that hits gearmass destroyed after dealing damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Two Gear Slam or Cog Tossess. If it hits one creature with both Gear Slams target is grappled (escape DC 14) and gearmass uses Engulf on target.

actions.name: Gear Slam
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, 10 ft., one creature,. 12 (2d8+3) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Cog Toss
actions.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit 20/60' one creature. 12 (2d8+3) bludgeoning damage and the target must make DC 14 Str save or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Engulf
actions.text: Engulfs Med or smaller creature grappled by it. Engulfed target is blinded restrained and unable to breathe and it must make DC 14 Con save at start of each of gearmass's turns or take 14 (4d6) acid. Any nonmagical ferrous metal armor weapons or other items target is wearing corrode at start of each of gearmass's turns. If object is either metal armor or metal shield being worn/carried it takes permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to AC it offers. Armor reduced to AC of 10 or shield that drops to a +0 bonus is destroyed. If object is a metal weapon it rusts as described in the Rust Metal trait. If gearmass moves engulfed target moves with it. Gearmass can have only one creature engulfed at a time.

added.name: Gelatinous Wall
added.immunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, fatigue, frightened, prone

traits.name: Engulfing Body
traits.text: A creature that enters the cubes space is subjected to the saving throw and consequences of its Engulf attack.

traits.name: Ooze Nature
traits.text: An ooze doesnt require air or sleep.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.text: While in sunlight, the cube has disadvantage on attack rolls.

traits.name: Transparent
traits.text: While the cube is motionless, creatures unaware of its presence must succeed on a DC 15 Perception check to spot it.

actions.name: A creature engulfed by the cube takes 10 (3d6) acid damage plus 9 (2d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage, can't breathe, is restrained, and takes 10 (3d6) acid damage plus 9 (2d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage at the start of each of the cubes turns
actions.text: It can be seen but has total cover. It moves with the cube. The cube can hold as many creatures as fit in its space without squeezing.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (3d6) acid damage plus 9 (2d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Engulf
actions.text: The cube moves up to its Speed. While doing so  it can enter Large or smaller creatures spaces. Whenever the cube enters a creatures space  the creature makes a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw. If the creature is unaware of the cubes presence  it makes its saving throw against Engulf with disadvantage. On a success  the creature may use its reaction  if available  to move up to half its Speed without provoking opportunity attacks. If the creature doesnt move  it is engulfed by the cube.

actions.name: An engulfed creature can escape by using an action to make a DC 13 Strength check
actions.text: On a success  the creature moves to a space within 5 feet of the cube. A creature within 5 feet can take the same action to free an engulfed creature  but takes 10 (3d6) acid damage plus 9 (2d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage in the process.

traits.name: Bred to the Saddle
traits.text: The gerridae can’t be charmed or frightened while it has a rider.

traits.name: Water Bound
traits.text: For every hour the gerridae spends on dry land, its hp maximum is reduced by 2 (1d4).

traits.name: Water Walker
traits.text: The gerridae can move across the surface of water as if it were harmless, solid ground. This trait works like the water walk spell.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The gerridae makes one Bite attack and one Claw attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) slashing damage.

traits.name: Blood Frenzy
traits.text: The ghast of Leng has advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its hp.

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.text: The ghast of Leng has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

traits.name: Sunlight Hypersensitivity
traits.text: The ghast of Leng takes 20 radiant damage when it starts its turn in sunlight. While in sunlight, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage.

traits.name: Forest Camouflage
traits.text: The ghillie dubh has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in forest terrain.

traits.name: One with the Trees
traits.text: If the ghillie dubh has spent at least 24 hours in a forest, it has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks while in that forest. In addition, it can spend 10 minutes focusing its attention on the forest and an invisible, sapling-shaped sensor anywhere in its forest within 1 mile of it. It can see and hear everything within 60 feet of this sensor, but it is deaf and blind with regard to its own senses while doing so. The sensor lasts for 1 minute or until the ghillie dubh dismisses it (no action required).

traits.name: Speak with Beasts and Plants
traits.text: The ghillie dubh can communicate with beasts and plants as if they shared a language.

actions.name: Slam
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Forest Knowledge (Recharge 6)
actions.text:

traits.name: Darakhul Fever
traits.text:
spread mainly through bite wounds, this rare disease makes itself known within 24 hours by swiftly debilitating the infected. A creature so afflicted must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw after every long rest. On a failed save the victim takes 14 (4d6) necrotic damage, and its hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. This reduction can't be removed until the victim recovers from darakhul fever, and even then only by greater restoration or similar magic. The victim recovers from the disease by making successful saving throws on two consecutive days. Greater restoration cures the disease; lesser restoration allows the victim to make the daily Constitution check with advantage. Primarily spread among humanoids, the disease can affect ogres, and therefore other giants may be susceptible. If the infected creature dies while infected with darakhul fever, roll 1d20, add the character's current Constitution modifier, and find the result on the Adjustment Table to determine what undead form the victim's body rises in. Adjustment Table Roll Result:

1-9 None; victim is simply dead

10-16 Ghoul

17-20 Ghast

21+ Darakhul

The husk can smother one Huge, two Large, or four Medium or smaller creatures at a time.

traits.name: Chaotic Evil
traits.text: The giant lanternfish radiates a Chaotic and Evil aura.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.text:
The giant lanternfishs innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 14). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components.

- **At Will:** Charm Person, Disguise Self (humanoid form), Major Image, Misty Step
- **1/Day Each:** Geas, Hallucinatory Terrain, Hypnotic Pattern, Scrying

actions.name: Dizzying Touch
actions.text: Melee Spell Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: The target is magically charmed for 1 hour or until it takes damage. While charmed in this way  it has disadvantage on Wisdom saving throws and ability checks.

actions.name: Claws
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (4d6 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.text: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage  and the target makes a DC 13 Constitution saving throw. On a failure  the target takes 10 (3d6) poison damage and is poisoned for 1 hour.

actions.name: Hypnotic Pattern
actions.text: (3rd-Level; S, Concentration) A swirling pattern of light appears at a point within 120 feet. Each creature within 10 feet of the pattern that can see it makes a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure  the creature is charmed for 1 minute. While charmed  the creature is incapacitated and its Speed is 0. The effect ends on a creature if it takes damage or if another creature uses an action to shake it out of its daze.

bonusActions.name: Misty Step
bonusActions.text: (2nd-Level; V) The giant lanternfish teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet. The giant lanternfish can't cast this spell and a 1st-level or higher spell on the same turn.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.text: The leech can breathe air and water.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage, and the leech attaches to the target. While attached, the leech doesn't attack. Instead, at the start of each of the leech's turns, the target loses 5 (1d4 + 3) hp due to blood loss.

The leech can detach itself by spending 5 feet of its movement. It does so after it drains 15 hp of blood from the target or the target dies. A creature, including the target, can use its action to detach the leech.

traits.name: Fluorescing Challenge
traits.text: Advantage on Cha (Intimidation) checks while agitated as its fluorescence flashes in a disorienting array.

bonusActions.name: Water Jet
bonusActions.text: Each creature within 5 ft. of shrimp is blinded until start of its next turn (DC 14 Dex negates). The shrimp then swims up to half its swimming speed with o provoking opportunity attacks.

added.name: Giant Mole Lizard
added.senses: Blindsight 10 ft., Tremorsense 60 ft.; Passive Perception 9

traits.name: Beast of Burden
traits.text: Is considered to be a Huge Beast for the purpose of determining its carrying capacity.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.text: In sunlight disadvantage on attacks and Wis (Perception) checks that use sight.

bonusActions.name: Mass Shove
bonusActions.text: Each Large or smaller creature within 10 ft. of the giant mole lizard and that isn't grappled by it must make DC 14 Str save or be pushed up to 15 ft. away from the lizard and knocked prone.

traits.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
traits.text: The mongoose has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

reactions.name: Defensive Roll
reactions.text: The mongoose adds its Athletics bonus to its AC against one attack that would hit it. To do so, the mongoose must see the attacker.

traits.name: Antennae
traits.text: The giant moth has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

actions.name: Proboscis
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage.

actions.name: Powdery Wings (1/Day)
actions.text: A 10-foot radius cloud of fine powder disperses from the giant moth. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Spiny Body
traits.text: A creature that touches pufferfish or hits it with melee attack while within 5 ft. of it takes 2 (1d4) piercing damage. While it is puffed up this damage increases to 5 (2d4).

traits.name: Water Breathing
traits.text: Can breathe only underwater.

bonusActions.name: Burst of Speed (Recharge 5–6)
bonusActions.text: Takes the Dash action.

bonusActions.name: Puff Up
bonusActions.text: For 1 min it increases in size by filling its stomach with air or water. While puffed up it is Medium doubles its damage dice on Bite and Spine attacks (included above) and makes Str checks and Str saves with advantage. If pufferfish lacks the room to become Medium it attains the max size possible in space available.

added.name: Giant Shark Bowl
added.immunities: lightning; blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, prone

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.text: The giant shark bowl can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Blood Frenzy
traits.text: The giant shark bowl has advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its hp.

traits.name: Electrical Charge
traits.text: When the giant shark bowl is subjected to lightning damage, it takes no damage and instead becomes charged for 1 minute. While charged, its attacks deal an extra 2 (1d4) lightning damage.

traits.name: Ooze Fish Bowl
traits.text: The shark bowl takes up its entire space. Other creatures can enter the space, but they are subjected to the bowl's Engulf and have disadvantage on the saving throw. Creatures inside the bowl can be seen but have total cover. A creature within 5 feet of the bowl can take an action to pull a creature out. Doing so requires a successful DC 15 Strength check, and the creature making the attempt takes 22 (3d10 + 6) piercing damage. The bowl can hold one Large creature or up to six Medium or smaller creatures inside it at a time.

traits.name: Symbiotically Bound
traits.text: The ooze and the giant shark's life forces have been entwined by an arcane force. They share statistics as if they were one monster and can't be separated.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The giant shark bowl makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its pseudopod.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) piercing damage.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Engulf
actions.text:
The giant shark bowl moves up to its speed. While doing so, it can enter Large or smaller creatures' spaces. Whenever the bowl enters a creature's space, the creature must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw.

On a successful save, the creature can choose to be pushed 5 feet back or to the side of the bowl. A creature that chooses not to be pushed suffers the consequences of a failed saving throw.

On a failed save, the bowl enters the creature's space, and the creature takes 22 (3d10 + 6) piercing damage and is engulfed. The engulfed creature can't breathe, is restrained, and takes 22 (3d10 + 6) piercing damage at the start of each of the bowl's turns. When the bowl moves, the engulfed creature moves with it.

An engulfed creature can try to escape by taking an action to make a DC 15 Strength check. On a success, the creature escapes and enters a space of its choice within 5 feet of the bowl.

traits.name: Foul Odor
traits.text: Any creature that starts its turn within 15 feet of the giant sloth must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or have disadvantage on its next attack roll or ability check.

traits.name: Hunter's Dash (1/Day)
traits.text: The giant sloth moves double its normal speed and has advantage on all of its attacks for 1 round.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The giant sloth makes two attacks: one with its claw and one with its bite. If the giant sloth is grappling a creature, it can also use its Sloth's Embrace once.

actions.name: Claw
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) slashing damage. The target is grappled (escape DC 15) if it is a Large or smaller creature and the sloth doesn't have another creature grappled.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (3d8 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Sloth's Embrace
actions.text: The giant sloth crushes a creature it is grappling by pulling the creature against its fetid, furry chest. The target must make a DC 15 Strength saving throw, taking 27 (6d8) bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature that fails the save is also stunned until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Snowball Concealment
traits.text: The giant snow beetle has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to hide if it is within 10 feet of a Large or larger snowball. It can attempt to hide even if another creature can see it clearly.

traits.name: Snowball Roll
traits.text: The giant snow beetle can spend 1 minute to roll up a ball of snow equal to its size.

actions.name: Pincer
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Rotten Snowball Shove (Recharge 6)
actions.text: The giant snow beetle tosses one of its carrion-filled snowballs at a point it can see within 20 feet of it. Each creature within 5 feet of that point must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a target takes 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage and becomes poisoned for 1 minute. On a success, a target takes half the damage and isn't poisoned. A poisoned creature can make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the poisoned condition on itself on a success.

actions.name: Snowball Shove
actions.text: The giant snow beetle tosses one of its rolled snowballs at a point it can see within 20 feet of it. Each creature within 5 feet of that point must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a target takes 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage and is knocked prone. On a success, a target takes half the damage and isn't knocked prone.

traits.name: Echolocation
traits.text: The bat can't use its blindsight while deafened.

traits.name: Keen Hearing
traits.text: The bat has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 13). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the bat can't bite another target. The bat regains hp equal to the necrotic damage dealt.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.text: While motionless indistinguishable from normal forest vegetation. Ex: small tree large branch.

traits.name: Forest Camouflage
traits.text: Has advantage on Dex (Stealth) checks made to hide in forested terrain.

traits.name: Trampling Charge
traits.text: If it moves 20'+ straight toward a creature and then hits it with Ram attack on same turn target: DC 13 Str save or be knocked prone. If target is prone stick can make one Spine attack vs. it as a bonus action.

bonusActions.name: Startling Display
bonusActions.text: Each creature within 5 ft. of the stick: DC 13 Int save or be incapacitated until end of its next turn. The walking stick then flies up to its flying speed with o provoking opportunity attacks.

added.name: Giant Water Elemental
added.immunities: poison; fatigue, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, unconscious

traits.name: Conductive
traits.text: If the elemental takes lightning damage, each creature sharing its space takes the same amount of lightning damage.

traits.name: Fluid Form
traits.text: The elemental can enter and end its turn in other creatures spaces and move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: Freeze
traits.text: If the elemental takes cold damage, its speed is reduced by 15 feet until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The elemental makes two slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (4d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Whelm
actions.text: The elemental targets each Large or smaller creature in its space. Each target makes a DC 15 Strength saving throw. On a failure  the target is grappled (escape DC 15). Until this grapple ends  the target is restrained and unable to breathe air. The elemental can move at full speed while carrying grappled creatures inside its space. It can grapple one Large creature or up to four Medium or smaller creatures.

added.name: Giant Water Scorpion
added.senses: Blindsight 60 ft., Darkvision 60 ft.; Passive Perception 10

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.text: The scorpion can hold its breath for 1 hour. If it is within 15 feet of the water’s surface, it can use its tail as a breathing tube and doesn’t need to hold its breath.

traits.name: Poison Injection
traits.text: When the scorpion hits with a proboscis attack against a grappled, paralyzed, restrained, or stunned creature, it deals an extra 10 (3d6) poison damage.

traits.name: Underwater Camouflage
traits.text: The scorpion has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide while underwater.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The giant water scorpion makes two claw attacks. If it is grappling a creature, it can use its proboscis once.

actions.name: Proboscis
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) piercing damage, and the target's Strength score is reduced by 1d4. The target dies if this reduces its Strength to 0. Otherwise, the reduction lasts until the target finishes a short or long rest.

actions.name: Claws
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage. The target is grappled (escape DC 13) if it is a Medium or smaller creature and the scorpion doesn't have another creature grappled.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Two Obsidian Axe or Firestorm Bolt attacks.

actions.name: Obsidian Axe
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, 10 ft., one target, 19 (3d8+6) slashing damage + 3 (1d6) cold and 3 (1d6) fire.

actions.name: Firestorm Bolt
actions.text: Ranged Spell Attack: +6 to hit, 120 ft., one target, 13 (3d6+3) fire + 10 (3d6) cold.

actions.name: Lava Geyser (Recharge 5-6)
actions.text: Gestures at a point on the ground it can see within 60' of it. A fountain of molten rock erupts from that point in a 10 ft. radius 40' high cylinder. The area is difficult terrain for 1 min. Each creature in the cylinder must make a DC 16 Dex save. On a failure a creature takes 24 (7d6) fire and is coated in hardened lava. On a success a creature takes half the damage and isn't coated in hardened lava. A creature coated in hardened lava has its speed halved while it remains coated. A creature including the coated creature can take its action to break and remove the hardened lava ending the effect.

traits.name: Death Malison
traits.text: When it dies the runes on its body flash a bright green then turn to mundane malachite. Each creature within 20' of giant: cursed 7 days (DC 16 Con negates) or until lifted by remove curse spell or similar. While cursed creature has disadvantage on saves and on first attack roll it makes on each of its turns. Fiends have disadvantage on the save.

traits.name: Rune-Powered Weapons
traits.text: Its weapon attacks are magical. When it hits with any weapon weapon deals extra 2d8 fire (included in below).

traits.name: Stone Camouflage
traits.text: Advantage on Dex (Stealth) checks made to hide in rocky terrain.

reactions.name: Runic Shield
reactions.text: Adds 4 to its AC vs. one attack that would hit it as green runes encircle the giant. To do so giant must see the attacker and can't be invisible

added.name: Giant, Lantern

traits.name: Hypnotic Luminescence
traits.text: Tendril on giant’s head sheds bright light in 60' radius and dim light extra 60'. When creature that can see the light starts its turn within 60' of giant creature charmed 24 hrs (DC 18 Cha negates) regarding giant as friendly acquaintance. If giant or one of its allies harms charmed creature this effect ends. If save succeeds/effect ends for it creature immune to giant's Hypnotic Luminescence for next 24 hrs. At start of its turn lantern giant chooses whether this light is active.

traits.name: Limited Amphibiousness
traits.text: Can breathe air and water but it needs to be submerged at least once every 4 hrs to avoid suffocating.

traits.name: Speak with Aquatic Creatures
traits.text: Communicate with Monstrosities and Beasts that have a swim speed as if they shared a language.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Three Tridents. Can replace one with Spellcasting.

actions.name: Trident
actions.text: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +12 to hit 10 ft. or range 20/60' 1 target. 18 (3d6+8) piercing damage or 21 (3d8+8) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

actions.name: Crush of the Deep (Recharge 5-6)
actions.text: Summons pressure of ocean depths in 40' cube of water centered on point it can see within 120' of it. Each creature in cube: 44 (8d10) bludgeoning damage (DC 17 Con half).

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.text: Cha (DC 15) no material components:At will: detect magic identify (as an action)3/day ea: control water freedom of movement water breathing

legendaryActions.name: Trident
legendaryActions.text: The lantern giant makes one Trident attack.

legendaryActions.name: Move
legendaryActions.text: The lantern giant moves up to half its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

legendaryActions.name: Crushing Blow (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.text: The lantern giant makes one Trident attack with Advantage. On a hit, the target also has the Prone condition if it is Huge or smaller.

added.legendaryActionsIntro: Legendary Action Uses: 3. Immediately after another creature's turn, the lantern giant can spend a use to take one of these actions. It regains all its uses at the start of each of its turns. _(Added by this site for major monsters; the DM can leave them out.)_

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Three Pitchfork attacks or it makes one Pitchfork attack then uses Grab and Throw. Alternatively it can make one pitchfork attack then use Grab and Throw.

actions.name: Pitchfork
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, 10 ft., one target, 20 (3d10+4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Rock
actions.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit 60/240' 20 (3d10+4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Grab
actions.text: Reaches out and grabs a Med or smaller creature it can see within 10 ft. of it. The target must make DC 15 Dex save or be grappled (escape DC 15) by the giant. Until this grapple ends the target is restrained.

actions.name: Throw
actions.text: Throws a creature it is grappling at a space it can see within 30' of it. The thrown creature takes 14 (4d6) bludgeoning damage and must make DC 15 Dex save or land prone. If the target space is occupied by another creature that creature must make DC 15 Dex save or take 14 (4d6) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone.

traits.name: Forged Forgery
traits.text: Thursir armorers wear armor forged from dwarven armor and shaped to resemble dwarven armor. Skilled blacksmiths can recognize and exploit this design quirk. When a creature proficient with smith’s tools scores a critical hit vs. thursir armorer armorer’s armor breaks reducing armorer’s AC by 5 until armorer repairs armor. If armorer is critically hit by any creature while its armor is broken armor shatters and is destroyed reducing armorer’s AC to 12.

bonusActions.name: Harness Dwarven Soul
bonusActions.text: Draws on the soul fragment trapped in one of the dwarven skulls on its belt. Armorer has advantage on ability checks when using smith's tools and on attack rolls using a battleaxe handaxe light hammer or warhammer until start of its next turn. It carries six skulls on its belt.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: Advantage: spell/magic effect saves.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.text: Weapon attacks are magical.

traits.name: Protect the Hearth
traits.text: When she is hit by a weapon attack up to two friendly creatures within 60' of her that can see her can use their reactions to move up to their speed toward priestess.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Uses Hearth Blessing then two Runic Staff attacks.

actions.name: Runic Staff
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, 10 ft., one target, 10 (2d6+3) bludgeoning damage and 4 (1d8) fire.

actions.name: Hearth Blessing
actions.text: Calls upon her deity and connection with the hearth to enhance her allies. She empowers one friendly creature she can see within 30' of her with one of the following options until start of her next turn.Hearth's Burn Target's weapon ignites and when target hits with the weapon weapon deals extra 3 (1d6) fire.Hearth's Comfort If target is charmed or frightened condition immediately ends. In addition target gains 5 (1d10) temp hp.Hearth's Protection Target's Armor Class increases by 2 and its armor is immune to spells and effects that target or affect the armor such as heat metal spell or a rust monster's antennae.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.text: Wis (DC 13): At will: mending spare the dying thaumaturgy3/day ea: cure wounds heat metal1/day: haste

added.name: Gigantura
added.languages: understands Aquan and Deep Speech, but can't speak

traits.name: Telescoping Eyes
traits.text: Advantage on Wis (Perception) checks that rely on sight and magical darkness doesn’t impede its darkvision. Also disadvantage on ability checks and saves vs. being blinded.

traits.name: Water Breathing
traits.text: Can breathe only underwater.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Horrific Gaze. Then one Bite and two Tail Slaps.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, 10 ft., one target, 25 (3d12+6) piercing damage. If target is a Huge or smaller creature it must make DC 18 Dex save or be swallowed by gigantura. A swallowed creature is blinded and restrained has total cover vs. attacks and effects outside gigantura and takes 21 (6d6) acid at start of each of gigantura's turns. Gigantura can have up to 2 Huge 4 Large 6 Medium or 8 Small creatures swallowed at one time. If gigantura takes 30+ damage on a single turn from a creature inside it gigantura must make DC 20 Con save at end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures which fall prone in a space within 10 ft. of gigantura. If gigantura dies swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from corpse by using 20' of move exiting prone.

actions.name: Tail Slap
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, 15 ft., one target, 17 (2d10+6) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Horrific Gaze
actions.text: Its telescoping eyes swirl disconcertingly in direction of one creature it can see within 60' of it. If target can see gigantura target stunned until end of its next turn (DC 18 Con negates). A target that successfully saves is immune to this gigantura's Horrific Gaze for the next 24 hrs.

legendaryActions.name: Bite
legendaryActions.text: The gigantura makes one Bite attack.

legendaryActions.name: Move
legendaryActions.text: The gigantura moves up to half its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

legendaryActions.name: Crushing Blow (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.text: The gigantura makes one Bite attack with Advantage. On a hit, the target also has the Prone condition if it is Huge or smaller.

added.legendaryActionsIntro: Legendary Action Uses: 3. Immediately after another creature's turn, the gigantura can spend a use to take one of these actions. It regains all its uses at the start of each of its turns. _(Added by this site for major monsters; the DM can leave them out.)_

added.name: Gilded Devil
added.resistances: cold; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks not made with silvered weapons
added.languages: Celestial, Common, Draconic, Infernal, telepathy 120 ft.

traits.name: Devil’s Sight
traits.text: Magical darkness doesn’t impede the gilded devil’s darkvision.

traits.name: Golden Flail
traits.text: The gilded devil’s Golden Flail attacks are magical. When the devil hits with the Golden Flail, the flail deals an extra 4d6 fire damage (included in the attack). In addition, the devil can transform the flail into gold jewelry or back into a weapon as a bonus action.

traits.name: Liar’s Largesse
traits.text: If a creature accepts a gift of jewelry from the gilded devil, the creature becomes cursed until cured by a remove curse spell or similar magic. While cursed, the creature has disadvantage on saving throws against the devil’s spells and abilities.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The gilded devil has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The gilded devil makes two Golden Flail attacks or three Hurl Flame attacks.

actions.name: Golden Flail
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 14 (4d6) fire damage.

actions.name: Hurl Flame
actions.text: Ranged Spell Attack: +7 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) fire damage.

actions.name: Teleport (Recharge 4–6)
actions.text: The gilded devil magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

actions.name: Voracious Greed
actions.text: The gilded devil magically consumes up to 1 cubic foot of nonmagical jewelry or coins made of precious material within 5 feet of it. It regains 5 hp for every 200 gp of the consumed objects' value. If the jewelry or coins are being worn or carried by a creature, that creature must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw to prevent the consumption.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.text:
The gilded devil casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15):

- **At Will:** alter self, detect thoughts, suggestion
- **3/Day Each:** charm person, scrying

bonusActions.name: Betrayal of Riches (Recharge 4–6)
bonusActions.text: One creature wearing jewelry (an object made of precious material and worth at least 100 gp) the gilded devil can see within 60 feet of it must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, the target takes 13 (3d8) bludgeoning damage and suffers an effect until it finishes a short rest. The effect is based on the location of the worn jewelry (devil's choice if worn in multiple locations): on upper limbs, its melee damage is halved; on lower limbs, its speed is halved; on head, it is blinded or deafened (devil's choice); on body, it has vulnerability to bludgeoning damage. On a success, the target takes half the damage and doesn't suffer an additional effect.

added.name: Glacial Corrupter
added.languages: understands all languages it knew in life but can't speak

actions.name: Longsword
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) slashing damage, or 7 (1d10 + 2) slashing damage if used with two hands.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Glacial Touch (Recharge 5–6)
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) cold damage. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or take 2 (1d4) cold damage at the start of each of its turns, as a frozen shard lodges itself in the wound. Any creature can take an action to remove the shard with a successful DC 12 Wisdom (Medicine) check. The shard crumbles to snow if the target receives magical healing.

A humanoid slain by this attack rises in 1 week as a glacial corrupter, unless the humanoid is restored to life or its body is destroyed.

added.name: Glacial Crawler
added.speed: 30 ft., Burrow 30 ft., Climb 20 ft., Swim 60 ft.
added.senses: Blindsight 60 ft., Tremorsense 60 ft.; Passive Perception 18

traits.name: Acidic Coating
traits.text: A creature that touches the crawler or hits it with melee attack while within 5 ft. of it takes 9 (2d8) acid.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.text: Can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Snow Camouflage
traits.text: Has advantage on Dex (Stealth) checks made to hide in snowy terrain.

traits.name: Tunneler

mythicActions.text: _Strength Saving Throw:_ DC 27, each creature within 10 feet of the godslayer. _Failure:_ The target is pushed up to 10 feet away and has the Prone condition.

traits.name: Easily Distracted
traits.text: Disadvantage on Wis (Perception) checks. In addition a creature that the golem can see or hear and that is within 30' of it can attempt to distract golem as a bonus action. Golem must make DC 10 Wis save or spend its next turn moving up to its speed toward the creature using its available actions on that creature.

actions.text: Exhales semi-digested decayed meat and vegetation in a 15 ft. cone. Each creature in that area: 14 (4d6) poison (DC 13 Con half).

traits.name: Construct Nature

traits.name: Immutable Form

traits.name: Infernal Tetanus
traits.text: A creature infected with this manifests symptoms 2d4 days after infection: fever headache sore throat and muscle aches. It affects the nervous system causing painful debilitating muscle spasms that eventually inhibit mobility speech and breathing. Until disease is cured at end of each long rest infected creature must make a DC 16 Con save. Fail: Creature's Dex score is reduced by 1d4 and is paralyzed for 24 hrs. Reduction lasts until creature finishes a long rest after disease is cured. If disease reduces creature’s Dex to 0 it dies. Success: creature instead suffers one level of exhaustion and until disease is cured or exhaustion is removed it must make DC 16 Con save to cast a spell with verbal component. A creature that succeeds on three saves recovers from the disease.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: Advantage: spell/magic effect saves.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.text: Weapon attacks are magical.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Two Chain attacks.

actions.name: Chain
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, 15 ft., one target, 18 (4d6+4) slashing damage and target contracts infernal tetanus disease (see above; DC 16 Con not diseased). Target is grappled (escape DC 14) if it is a Large or smaller creature and golem doesn't have another creature grappled.

actions.name: Imprison
actions.text: Creates prison of chains around an up to Med creature grappled by it. Imprisoned: restrained and takes 14 (4d6) piercing damage at start of each of its turns. Imprisoned creature or creature within 5 ft. of golem can use action to free imprisoned creature. Doing so requires DC 16 Str check and creature attempting takes 7 (2d6) piercing damage.

traits.name: Ice Cavity
traits.text: Ice block torse it can liquefy and refreeze trapping and preserving creatures. If golem takes 15+ fire on a single turn cavity liquefies if frozen. When cavity is frozen creature that touches golem or hits it with melee attack while within 5 feet: 9 (2d8) cold. When cavity liquefied creature within 5 ft. of golem can use action to pull petrified creature out of golem if golem has one inside. Doing so requires successful DC 16 Str check and creature attempting: 9 (2d8) cold.

traits.name: Standing Leap (Frog Form)
